method: Per-epic Sonnet reviewers against six prototype maps, each review re-checked by an adversarial Sonnet verifier; plus a verified data-model delta and a verified reverse check.

themes.title: Contract-centred billing model
themes.description: Billing route, Type 1/2/3 and protected default Type 1s replaced by holders, dated Contract versions, standalone lines, one No contract (RVG), mandatory Contract per Procedure, staged review, authorisation snapshot. XL, split into model, versioning screens, picker.

themes.title: Pricing, units and modifiers
themes.description: Price, rate and discount held on the Procedure with no reason, Contract flag gating anaesthetist, no-charge invoice, modifier split above four, RVG hidden-key master, modifier records with explanations, age pre-applied, out-of-range warns, completion rules reworked. XL.

themes.title: Hospital intake matching screen
themes.description: No review-and-merge screen exists; HL7/FHIR and PDF rows auto-apply. Need staged rows, match/create/Draft List/reject, per-row change type, differences for approval, unmatched queue, day move as cancel plus new, edits until AUTHORISED. XL.

themes.title: NHI mandatory and text as received
themes.description: Remove provisional patients and NHI pending; waiting-for-NHI queue; procedure text kept per source with time; separate invoice description. M, bundled with intake.

themes.title: Prepayment and holding account
themes.description: Prepaid Contract triggers prepayment at line price, admin approval with letter, payable to holding account, second pair at authorise, refund on cancel, no automatic balance. Anaesthetist currently paid before the procedure. XL.

themes.title: Events, additional invoices and credit notes
themes.description: Post-op addendum Booking replaced by events on the Procedure, free-form additional invoices, credit then rebill, negative payables netted in a weekly payment cycle. XL.

themes.title: Edit window until AUTHORISED and anaesthetist views
themes.description: Anaesthetist edits stay open on SUBMITTED, List leaves main view at AUTHORISED, balances show invoices immediately, search and scroll-back. M.

themes.title: OQ-81 reversal: unavailability is never a conflict
themes.description: Remove availability conflict kind, make closed sessions non-assignable by the office, route sickness through return-or-assign to a Draft List. M to L, independent.

themes.title: Single-Booking move and notification pool
themes.description: Anaesthetist moves one Booking into a new List in a colleague's free Slot; pool notices gain resolve tick, count, show-resolved and an ask-the-office source. M.

themes.title: Payer, insurer, balances and warnings
themes.description: Payer name and email on the Booking, insurer and approval number on the Booking, patient balance alerts, remaining warning rules, ledger positions, split as a Booking action. L, after Contract rework.

themes.title: Profile, reporting and admin polish
themes.description: Drop GST period, add bank details, monthly GST of payments passed on, flat owed list, preferred pairing ordering, audit exclusions, cutover load, master calendar, simulated sign-in, scale and privacy demos, point-of-need help. M, mostly small.

epics.title: Schedule canvas, Slots and Lists
epics.observations: All six EP-01 items are upheld as Matches after independent re-checking of the catalogue text and code. I found no missed acceptance criteria and no contradictions. The nine acceptance criteria of US-01.1.6 and the two of US-01.2.2 each trace to code. Catch-up phases 28 (canvas), 29 (statuses and series), 32b (finder ordering) and 32c (out-of-hours) cover this epic. Minor observations that are not gaps: (1) Mobile and web 'My calendar' month grids draw AM and PM only. An OOH session is reachable via the day panel and the Find cover 'My availability' card, so it is not graded as a gap. (2) OQ-139 (what a public Slot shows) is Proposed (status 1). The prototype has no 'Public' status, which matches the recommendation that public is a kind of unavailable. It would be a master-data row if AA says otherwise. (3) Status colours are one of six design tokens. This is the design rule, so I accept it as 'editable colour'. (4) US-01.1.6 leaves open who may open an OOH session when the office is closed. It is not an acceptance criterion and has no demo effect. (5) US-01.1.5, the A and B split of a session, is outside this task, and one List per Slot is enforced today. Demo beats S1 to S5 are unaffected.

epics.title: Booking intake and change handling
epics.observations: Structural: the prototype has one append-only audit trail (mutate.ts) and a shared HistorySheet reachable from every Booking, so US-02.5.5 and most of US-02.5.8 are in place. Every gap sits downstream of the intake rebuild. There is no hospital-list application path (the matching screen, FT-02.1 / Phase 33, is not built; HL7/FHIR S12 to S15 are interim stand-ins now Future scope), no unmatched queue (US-02.1.4, US-11.1.5), no stubs, and no multi-user office (US-13.5.1; one hard-coded actor, Kirsty W.). The procedure text is the one real contradiction on the history side: EditProcedureSheet still lets people hand-edit it, which US-02.5.7 now forbids, and feed updates never replace it. The prototype also actively contradicts the stub rule: createBooking/upsertPatient turns a no-NHI incoming row into a Booking with a provisional Patient (and the seed carries one, shown as 'NHI pending'), against US-11.1.4 and US-02.6.1. Dependencies: US-02.5.7/02.5.8 depend on the matching screen (hospital text replacing rooms' text, hospital-sourced history entry) and US-03.1.9 (text shown with the Contract and RVG choice); US-02.6.1/02.6.3 depend on US-11.1.4 and US-11.1.5; US-02.6.3 depends on US-02.6.1. The old contract model (governingContractId) will be reworked by EP-04, so US-02.5.5's Contract-selection history needs rechecking then. Status caveats: 02.5.5 is Proposed; 02.5.7, 02.5.8, 02.6.1 and 02.6.3 are Verify (agreed in the room or answered by Donald only, not yet seen by Greg/Vanessa/Ben as applicable), so wording may still move. Demo-script impact: S1 (feed messages MSG-STG-1001 to 1004, 1010) and S4 (Exceptions) change when hospital updates replace procedure text and no-NHI rows become stubs; any beat that hand-edits an operation via 'Edit operation' changes because hand edits are removed.

epics.title: Booking and Procedure capture (anaesthetist)
epics.observations: I graded only US-03.4.1 here (status Verify, 3). The Contract change mechanics from catch-up Phases 20 and 21a are solid and cover every acceptance criterion except the payer. The single gap is a dependency on US-11.2.2 and OQ-140 (payer on each Procedure, 17 Nov). The prototype holds one payer per Booking: Booking.payer, setBookingPayer, the booking-payer-row and billablePartyForProcedure all assume it. Closing it is a cross-epic change that sizes under EP-11 (it also touches US-08.2.x invoicing and prepayment per payer). Staged demos that switch a Booking to No contract · RVG would need re-checking once the payer moves. I did not trace which S1 to S5 demo beats use the contract change.

epics.title: Contracts
epics.observations:
EP-04 is largely built: Party master with refusals, flat Contract editor, five pricing kinds, price ranges, derived destinations, the system backstops (open-price per destination, plus RVG per hospital tag and Special holder), and the shared BillingCard step rail mirrored for the anaesthetist. The gaps are narrow and cluster in three places.

1. Anaesthetist price override (US-04.2.2 and US-04.2.14, and now US-04.1.1; also US-03.5.1 outside this epic). Contract.anaesthetistMayOverridePrice is stored and editable (editor refuses it on non-RVG kinds) but never read when the anaesthetist prices a Procedure. OverrideCard (shared/capture/BtmCaptureBlock.tsx:229) is always shown, demands a reason (OverrideCard and validateBookingForBilling), and a fixedFee override also clears 'Needs a price' (contracts.ts:494, fee.ts:321), so it can replace a fixed price or stand in for a typed amount on a hospital backstop (a further hole in US-04.3.9). One fix, sized M: gate the card by the governing Contract's flag (read-only otherwise, nothing at all on fixed or prepaid), drop the mandatory reason, reseed typed-price review beats (reviewFlagBookings typedPriceBooking, S3/S4), bump PERSIST_VERSION, and fix demo-guide line 773 ('There is no override any more'). I upgraded US-04.1.1 from Partial to Contradicts because its table and rules state the same override rule.

2. Add-booking rail variant (US-04.3.9). shared/flows/ContractRail.tsx (ManualBookingForm, ProcedureContractRow) keeps the retired 'Other price' switch and lacks the 'No contract' heading and RVG backstop that BillingCard has. Point it at the BillingCard's ContractCombo and backstop pair, or reuse BillingSteps in the sheet. Affects only a presenter who adds a booking by hand; the S1 beat uses the BillingCard and is correct.

3. Seed realism. The five hospital plain RVG Contracts carry no funding tag and so show under Special; hospital > tag RVG-kind Contracts exist only at the Contract's rate (Southern Cross SXAP, CPH HNZ, St George's ACC). No Forte SXAP Contract or rvgDiscount Contract is seeded, so the Forte backstop AC and the 'Fixed discount' AC need hand-made Contracts. Any retag must keep the S4 single-tag fill-in (St George's has ACC only). Needs a PERSIST_VERSION bump.

4. Payer on each Procedure (Donald, 17 November, OQ-140, US-11.2.2, AA to confirm). EP-04's stories (04.1.1, 04.1.5, 04.2.1, 04.2.14, 04.3.3) now say 'the Procedure's payer'; the prototype holds the payer on Booking.payer and billablePartyForProcedure reads it. I graded these stories on their own rules and left the move to the US-11.2.2 phase, since Contract-to-invoice behaviour is identical for single-payer Bookings. When that phase lands, billablePartyForProcedure's signature, Booking.payer, and the demo-guide wording (03-demo-script.md around line 636) change with it.

5. Open questions OQ-114 (delivery beyond email and post) and OQ-136 (holder references the Booking must collect) are unresolved; the prototype follows the interim readings, no work needed. Story screenshots (US-04.1.1, 04.2.1, 04.2.2) are noted as showing the retired model and need recapture after the build.

6. Scripted beats. S1 (Contract choice on the rail), S3 (invoices to holder or payer) and S4 (prepayment on Souter's list, billing failure with COS fixed fee) depend on the model as built; gaps 1, 3 and 4 are the ones that could alter them when closed. No beat is broken by current state.

epics.title: RVG master data and fee calculation rules
epics.observations: EP-05 is largely built on the OLD RFP reading: Contract Type 1/2/3, Method 3 rate x time lines, override with mandatory reason in three shapes, additional procedure = time units only, Type 3 BTM fallback. Verification regraded two items (US-05.2.6 and US-05.2.8, both Partial to Contradicts) and added concrete wrong behaviours: a $0 total raises no invoice (requirement: a no-charge invoice), OverrideCard refuses a $0 charge, a prepaid deposit is netted off a recomputed fee so a difference invoice is raised automatically, a Contract change does not clear a typed price, and price changes are never flagged at review (reviewFlags.ts has no such flag). Matches stand only for US-05.2.1 (per-anaesthetist unit value, Contract rate and discount) and US-05.2.7 (GST held ex and added at the foot). Structural dependencies: pricing kinds, price ranges, open price and 'Needs a price' depend on the EP-04 flat Contract rework (and the OQ-133 backdating answer); the ACC funding tag on US-04.2.17; the primary-procedure flag on US-03.2.1; held-price rules on prepayment (EP-06) and the AUTHORISED snapshot (US-04.3.5). The domain-model delta already lists DM-13 (RVG group), DM-14 (single typed price), DM-15 (multi-procedure) and DM-50; suggested order is DM-13, then DM-50 with DM-14, then DM-15. Admin RVG and Modifier screens are view only; RVG codes are keyed by code, so the duplicate-code type-ahead cannot be shown without a hidden system key. Pure billing code in domain/billing/fee.ts means many changes are one-place edits, with a PERSIST_VERSION bump for seed or shape changes. Demo-guide impact: S4 Beat 1 invoice figures (split Booking totals) and the bariatric Type 3 Booking change if the modifier split, 'Needs a price' or optional times alter totals; S4 Beat 4 contract effective-dating conflicts with the undated-rate rule; S1/S2 override narration ('mandatory reason') changes. Date-driven behaviours (backdated price range, held prices) need demo buttons. No OutOfScope items.

epics.title: Prepayment
epics.observations:
EP-06 as scoped here (FT-06.2 plus three stories) is a substantial gap, and the independent re-check confirms the reviewer's picture. The prototype has only the Phase 09 and catch-up Phase 20 prepayment, and code comments mark most of it 'INTERIM until Phase 27'. That means: a prepayment requirement derived from a prepaid Contract (correctly per Procedure, with the Booking flagged if any Procedure is), an office-only 'Raise pre-procedure invoice' button that sends at once, the balance run netting the prepayment, and an ACCPAY that goes to the anaesthetist and is released on receipt. Structural changes needed:

1. Payer on each Procedure (US-11.2.2, OQ-140), moved off Booking.payer. This drives one invoice per payer, a per-payer lock, and the Booking-level warning text.
2. An approval step on the outgoing-invoices screen with an AA on/off setting (US-13.7.4), plus the prepayment letter (US-06.3.6).
3. An AA Holding creditor in the internal ledger and the Xero simulator, a second transfer pair after List authorisation (US-06.4.1, OQ-125), and refund and move handling (US-06.5.2, US-06.5.4).
4. Removing the split-deposit prepayment shape (prepaymentDetail split/depositAmount) and its seed, UI text and test coverage, so the prepaid amount is always the Procedure's price. BillingCard, OfficeBillingSetup, InvoiceDocument and the seed audit all reference it.
5. OQ-120 on naming the anaesthetist on the invoice is still open.

Demo guide beats that would change: S4 beat 1 (Fri 24 Souter AM, Annette Riley, whose seeded $800 deposit goes away) and the Xero and payables walk-through. The seeded paid prepayment INV0001 (Fri 24 PM, already disbursed) needs re-seeding. PERSIST_VERSION must be bumped. Most of this work overlaps EP-08, EP-09, EP-10, EP-11 and EP-13, so it should be planned together to avoid double counting.

epics.title: List approval workflow
epics.observations: Only US-07.2.2 was in scope. Its gap comes almost entirely from the 17 November change to a payer on each Procedure (US-11.2.2, OQ-140 open, AA to confirm), together with US-11.2.4 (child warning per Procedure) and the delivery and prepayment grouping stories. The prototype built Phase 21 on one BookingPayer per Booking, with a single writer (setBookingPayer) kept deliberately contained. Moving to a per-Procedure payer touches the Procedure type, the payer actions, childPayerOn and payerContactMissing, whoIsBilled and invoice addressee resolution, the Booking and Review payer UI, the prepayment grouping per payer, the seed (a Booking with two Procedures billed to payers, each leaving a child as payer) and a PERSIST_VERSION bump from 44. Once the payer is per Procedure, the Review change is small: move the Paid by payer and its Change into each Procedure stack and emit per-Procedure warning rows. OQ-135 (Disabled Contract flag) is unresolved. The no-flag default (D81) is a one-rule addition if answered 'flag'. No new demo control is needed, since Review, the flags and the Contract-change Approve are all manually reachable. Demo guide beats that name 'the payer' per row or the optional payer-review List (S2 Beat 4: Chen Fri 17 Jul, Ella Moana, one warning per Booking) would need rewording.

epics.title: Billing/Invoice Engine and internal ledger
epics.observations: All four stories turn on one structural change: the payer moves from Booking.payer to each Procedure (OQ-140, Donald 17 Nov, not yet confirmed by AA). It touches the Booking and Procedure types, setBookingPayer and PayerSheet (plus the 'copy to other Procedures billing the same payer, ticked by default' prompt), a Paid by line per Procedure, billablePartyForProcedure and payerCounterparty, partyOptionsFor and isBillablePartyOn, invoiceDeliveryFor, payerDetails and billedToFor, buildInvoicesForBooking grouping, prepayment grouping (US-06.3.1), childPayerOn and payerContactMissing, the seed and a PERSIST_VERSION bump. Build it once under US-11.2.2 (EP-11); sizes on 08.1.1, 08.2.1 and 08.4.2 assume that move is done together with them (US-04.3.5 lock and US-06.3.1 depend on it too). US-08.2.3 has a separate gap: a free-typed 'another person' share with name and email or postal address (new counterparty source, contact validation, delivery, Xero contact), plus the under-18 warning, which today ignores split shares (childPayerOn never reads Procedure.split, so a patient gap share under a holder-billed Contract is not warned). Demo guide beats at risk: S3 billing run and invoices (docs/demo-guide/03-demo-script.md around lines 599-644: Brian Holt's one invoice, Alan Prentice's nib $132.50 split, Grace Park's guardian Hana Park, the To post payer) where it says 'payer named on the Booking', and the review-queue payer aside (~554-564, Demo actions > Raise sample warnings). Seeded amounts need not change if each Procedure's payer is seeded from the old Booking payer. A new beat could show two Procedures on one Booking billed to different payers, and a split naming another person. No new demo triggers are required: authorising a List already drives the billing run.

epics.title: Xero integration
epics.observations: Only US-09.1.3 was graded. It is the Xero side of US-06.5.1 (AA Holding account), US-06.3.1 (prepayment invoice) and US-06.4.1 (settlement), and should be built with them. That needs a holding-account Xero contact that is never paid and excluded from payment runs and archiving, a payee change in handoffCase for kind prePayment, and a second transfer pair created at authorisation in the billing run. Today the run only nets the deposit with a 'Less pre-payment deposit already invoiced' line (invoiceBuild.ts), which may need rethinking. Code comments in slotActions.ts and listMoveActions.ts already assume the holding-account behaviour, so the move-booking logic is consistent with the target. Likely PERSIST_VERSION bump if seeded Xero pairs (the prepaymentPaid List, Fri 24 PM, INV0001/BC0001) change payee. Demo guide scenarios S3 (Money end-to-end) and S4 (Fri 24 prepayment) would change what the Xero simulator shows.

epics.title: Payments, disbursement and AA fees
epics.observations:
Structural: the main EP-10 issue is that the prototype treats paying the anaesthetist as an in-system action (admin 'Run payables', Xero-sim 'Pay now', actor 'Payables run'). FT-10.2, US-09.2.4 and OQ-111 (answered 4 Nov) say Xero's payables run makes the payment and the engine detects and records it. The fix is to move the payout into the Xero simulator as a badged demo action, add webhook and poll detection of an ACCPAY payment, and turn the Admin monitor card into read-only tracking. The disbursement actions (runPayables, disbursePayable) have exactly two callers (BillingMonitorScreen, DemoXero), so the change is contained. Closely tied to US-09.2.4 in EP-09.

Dependencies: US-10.2.7 (weekly payment cycle, Proposed, OQ-47 open; Greg now proposes Monday to Sunday week, Thursday payment) is not built (no ISO week, close or reconciliation step) and sits outside this item list; US-10.2.6 and the 'next payables run' wording of US-10.2.1 depend on it. Whether BCTI approval equals release is part of OQ-47. BCTI count and period (OQ-29, one per payment or per weekly run) would change the per-procedure ACCPAY model US-10.2.6 relies on. Prepayments and the AA Holding account are not modelled in UI at all (only comments), so prepaid money can currently be disbursed like any other; that belongs to the EP-06/08 prepayment work but bears on the one-path story. AA fee never netted (US-10.3) is unaffected.

Demo-script impact: S3 Beat 3 (03-demo-script.md ~519-531) and S4 part-payment steps (~652-655: Run payables, Payment received full, Run payables again), 02-workflows Workflow 7 step 6, and 01-personas 'Run disbursements' use the in-app Run payables button; re-homing to a Xero simulator action changes those beats. A bulk-remittance tab (US-10.2.4) is additive to the Xero sim only. US-10.2.1 and US-10.1.1 need no code change. Any seed-shape change needs a PERSIST_VERSION bump (currently 26).

epics.title: Patients and billable parties
epics.observations: All gaps in EP-11 trace to one structural change: the payer moves from Booking.payer (aa-prototype/src/domain/types.ts:812, written only by setBookingPayer in store/payerActions.ts:134) onto each Procedure. It is read by billablePartyForProcedure, payerDetails, childPayerOn, payerContactMissing, invoiceBuild (one invoice per Booking per distinct party), the Xero handoff, prepayment grouping and Review flags. Doing it needs a PERSIST_VERSION bump and seed changes (the guardian Hana Park payer and the payer-review Bookings). It also needs the 'apply to the other Procedures' ticked offer, later-added Procedure inheritance (addProcedure currently creates no payer), a payer line with relationship and the 'Email or postal address needed' and 'Under 18' warnings in each Procedure's 'Paid by' line (PaidByRow today shows the invoiced party or split for US-08.2.3), 'not billed yet' wording, removal of the Booking-level Payer section, and re-captured screenshots (US-11.2.x images show the per-Booking payer). US-11.2.1, 11.2.3 and 11.2.4 are small only once US-11.2.2 is built; size the move once, under US-11.2.2 or FT-11.2. What already matches: Contract-decides rule, billsTo, NZ Post address, Different payer tick, contact-required asking and Review flag, mild child warning with one to-do per Booking. Open questions: OQ-140 (per-Procedure payer; also affects US-08.2.3 split naming another person, US-06.3.1 prepayment grouping, US-08.2.1 shared invoices), OQ-122 (posted invoices; the prototype provisionally accepts post alone) and OQ-114 (delivery beyond email and post; prototype is email else post). Event billable party (US-03.7.1) and the balances alert are graded in other epics; no event billable-party code was found in src. No new demo triggers are needed, since all of this is user-driven. The guardian beat (Grace Park, Hana Park) and the child-warning beat in the demo guide would change to the per-Procedure line; S1 to S5 impact was not checked in detail.

epics.title: Anaesthetist profile and reporting
epics.observations: EP-12 slice here is FT-12.2 plus US-12.2.1. FT-12.2's own body states rules (flat list; monthly GST report of payments AA passed on; ledger not Xero), so it is graded normally, not Grouping. The ageing concept lives in three places that must change together: web Accounts 'Overdue' sub-tab and route (/web/accounts/overdue), the web Dashboard 'Receivables aging' panel with its onViewOverdue link (the dashboard is US-12.2.3 and links to US-08.3.5 'financial position'; check whether that story wants ageing at all before removing the panel), and the mobile AgeChip. Add bookingId and listId to AccpayInvoiceRow so both apps can link to the Booking. The GST report (sibling US-12.2.2, status Verify, graded elsewhere) should switch from billing.receipts to disbursements (billing.disbursements has atISO) and drop the period selector and the masters gstPeriod read (retired in US-12.1.2), and add a download/print action on web (US-03.1.4). The ledger-not-Xero rule already holds: all these views read state.billing. OQ-123 (billing-practice reporting hooks) and OQ-134 (overdue alerts vs prepayment alert, which affects US-06.3.2 and US-11.3.2, not this list) are unresolved and do not change either grade; OQ-123 can be a presenter talking point. Demo guide: S3 Beat 3 narrates 'does not remain under Overdue', Beat 4 mentions 'Payables, GST activity and Overdue', docs/demo-guide/01-personas mentions receivables ageing, and 04-presenter-cheat-sheet.md around line 372 says 'aging is derived'; these need rewording. S1, S2, S4 and S5 are unaffected.

epics.title: Admin oversight and master data
epics.observations: Only US-13.1.1 and US-13.7.1 are in scope. US-13.1.1 holds: the Day grid, the Draft List band and the drill-in all exist, and OQ-139 (public Slot display) could later change only the Public text or colour. The current List-kind treatment matches the question's own recommendation. US-13.7.1 has two real gaps. (1) The child warning must go from one per Booking to one per Procedure billed to the payer, with the to-do list collapsing to one row per Booking. This touches the warning key, openWarnings, clearWarning and clearances, the triangle counts, the ProcedureStack display and the Day-block outline, and it is linked to OQ-140 and US-11.2.4. (2) There is no patient-balance warning. It needs a per-patient balance and invoice-age fact from the US-11.3.2 work, a fixed 90-day threshold until the US-13.7.4 settings page exists, strong over it, mild under it, and mild for a credit. Prepayment strength escalation (US-06.3.2) is not required here because strength is 'not yet set'. The extra splitDoesNotFit rule is outside the story's list but harmless. Demo guide beats affected: S2 Beat 3 (Ella Moana's child-payer warning and Grace Park's 'Raise sample warnings', around lines 555 to 564 of docs/demo-guide/03-demo-script.md) would change wording. S4 Beat 1 (prepayment) is unaffected. No scripted beat shows a balance warning, so one would be added.

epics.title: Health systems integration
epics.observations: EP-14 is mostly a parent of FT-14.1 to FT-14.6 (Future Work lane), but its body states three rules of its own: the first-release sync of both integrated hospitals into the matching screen, the NHI lookup being in scope, and the adapter and configuration-matrix design. The prototype's HL7/FHIR pipeline is already badged Future scope (catch-up Phase 14, to be demoted in Phase 34), so the Future-lane message is in place. The real gap is structural and sits in EP-02: there is no hospital download or matching screen (FT-02.1, US-02.1.5, Phase 33). Until then, integrationActions applyEffect writes hospital messages directly as Bookings onto Dr Souter's existing ACTIVE List. The first-release sync depends on that screen being built and on those messages being rerouted into it, which is also where the OQ-118 stub-at-intake question interacts. OQ-109 part 1 (St George's and Southern Cross vs Forte) is unresolved, so feed names may change, and part 2 is only assumed (4 Nov, not yet seen by AA). Demo impact: the S1 beat (MSG-STG-1001 lands Sarah Mitchell on Souter's Tue 28 Jul AM List) would gain an office review-and-merge step, and the 'Fire hospital message' triggers would change. S4's Christchurch Public mapping-fix beat stays but is framed as Future. The NHI lookup beat (S2) is unaffected.

epics.title: Non-functional requirements
epics.observations: EP-15 is mostly cross-cutting and infrastructure; only US-15.0.8 is real new prototype work. (1) US-15.0.8 needs a new Help/Support panel in the Admin app (office staff are the audience): phone and email lines, a single configurable support-hours string (OQ-137 also affects US-02.5.4, so keep it one constant), and optionally a mock ticket list with a demo 'advance ticket' control. It is independent of other epics. (2) US-15.0.7 already holds because everything reads one reactive persisted store; the refresh mechanism is unagreed with AA, so no build is needed now; an optional PWA-only 'Office changes this Booking's time' chip would help show it on a phone (relates to US-15.0.3). (3) US-15.0.5 is satisfied by the existing billing Vitest suites and purity test; when the flat Contract model (EP-04, Donald's 5 November decisions, cited by this story) lands, new resolution and override rules must add worked-example tests in contracts.test.ts and keep domainPurity.test.ts green. (4) The ~28,000 invoices/year figure is only a narrated counter (settings.volumeStory, shown in Admin Reference views and Demo Xero); a real volume demo would need a larger seed, a PERSIST_VERSION bump and care over the localStorage budget, and is optional. The hosting, security, DR and CI/CD technical-discussion bullets are presenter-explainable only. No scripted beats S1 to S5 break.

items.summary: Epic's own model (rolling canvas, AM/PM Slot per anaesthetist, free by default, List placed in a Slot, Draft List with no anaesthetist, 'slot' never in UI) is built; real gaps sit in children US-01.5.2, 01.5.4, 01.6.3, 01.4.7.

items.requirement_says: A Slot with no List has no surgeon or hospital. A List sits in one Slot and, once assigned, has exactly one anaesthetist, surgeon, hospital, day and session (active List); a Draft List has all but the anaesthetist.

Booked Lists carry hospitalId/surgeonId, date, session and anaesthetist on one record. hospitalId and surgeonId are optional: EditListSheet allows 'None (AA rooms / unassigned)' hospital, private Lists can be 'Surgeon TBC' (amber flag), public/preop can have no surgeon, phone-advice surgeon optional. No null-anaesthetist List.

items.summary: One generator writes an AM and a PM Slot per active anaesthetist per day, all Free, paints leave and series, then recurring bookings on top. A recurring booking on a closed Slot becomes a Draft List. Views show free and leave sessions.
items.requirement_says: The Scheduling Engine creates an AM and a PM Slot for every active anaesthetist for every day across the rolling horizon, even with no List. New Slots start free. Generation paints the anaesthetist's calendar first, then recurring bookings on top. A recurring booking on an unavailable Slot becomes a Draft List. One List per Slot. Out-of-hours is never generated.
items.prototype_does: generateCanvasForDates writes AM and PM only, from each anaesthetist's start date. Each Slot starts at the default (Free) status. Seed leave and series are painted next. Recurring bookings then go on top, and a clash on a closed status is returned as a clash and turned into a Draft List by the store (clashDraftsInto). Admin Day grid, mobile Forward Lists (open and day-off rows), web Lists table rows (open session rows with 'open for bookings' text) and the web Dashboard all show free and leave sessions. One List per Slot is enforced. The clock roll-forward uses the same generator.

items.summary: Admins set default AM, PM and out-of-hours times in Schedule settings. A session can override them with its own times, and 'Use default' clears the override. An all-day booking is simply AM plus PM.
items.requirement_says: Admins set default start and end times for AM and PM Slots and for the out-of-hours Slot (18:00 by default). Each Slot can override the defaults. An all-day booking uses both AM and PM. A Slot keeps its standard shape on screen even when its List has one Booking.
items.prototype_does: Master data > Schedule settings shows a table over SESSIONS_IN_ORDER (AM, PM, OOH) and an edit sheet. setSlotDefaultTimes is office-only and checks HH:mm and start before end. Sessions without their own times follow at once (effectiveSlotTimes). Per-session overrides are set through SessionTimesFields (with 'Use default'), setSlotTimes and the OOH PM-end rule. The seeded defaults are AM 07:30-12:30, PM 13:00-17:30 and OOH 18:00-21:00. There is no all-day type, so an all-day booking is AM plus PM.
items.verify_note: I checked that the OOH default (18:00) is part of the same settings table and action, and that overrides are per Slot, with a default equal to the Slot's time left unset so later default changes reach it. items.summary: Nothing lets an admin split an AM or PM session into A and B Lists: a Slot holds at most one List in the types, store guards, selectors and all three apps. The story is only Proposed, with design points unresolved.
items.requirement_says: An admin can split an anaesthetist's AM or PM session into two Lists (AM A and AM B, or PM A and PM B), each with its own surgeon, hospital and Bookings, following the pairing rule. At most two per session, the split is not offered again once split, and Lists are not split by default (recurring-booking Lists included). It is the one exception to one List per Slot. Proposed: per-half times, how a List already holding Bookings is split, finder and schedule treatment and Draft List halves are undecided.

AssignedList has a single slotId, SlotView carries one optional list, and assignListToSlot (and the move and Draft assignment paths) refuse an occupied Slot with slotOccupied. Searches for split, half, A/B and two-surgeon concepts in non-test src found nothing relevant.

No admin 'Split session' action in the SlotDrawer, and no guard preventing a second split
Admin Day grid block, web ListsScreen and WeekStrip, and mobile forward lists show one List per session; each would need two stacked or halved rows
Projected recurring Lists must stay unsplit and Draft List half handling is undefined
Conflict derivation, move, assign, booking counts, billing and submit flows assume one List per Slot
Seed has no split example; no demo path or S1 to S5 beat

items.summary: The office opens (today or later, one a day, own times allowed), fills (new List or Draft List) and closes an empty out-of-hours session. It is never generated and the anaesthetist cannot open one. It shows after PM, and finders offer it only when free. Every acceptance criterion is covered.
items.requirement_says: The office opens one out-of-hours Slot per anaesthetist per day (today included). It starts free at 18:00 by default with its own times allowed. It is never generated and the anaesthetist cannot open one. The finder offers it when free. The office assigns a new List or a Draft List to it. Marking it unavailable while it holds a List follows the normal rule. The office can close an empty one. Billing is as for any List.
items.prototype_does: openOutOfHoursSession is office-only (refusal for non-office or integration), refuses past dates, a day with no row and a second one. It takes optional own times, validated against the PM end, and stores times equal to the default as unset. The Day grid shows a per-row hover 'open out-of-hours session' button (only when the selected date is today or later and none is open). OpenOutOfHoursSheet has SessionTimesFields, and the drawer then offers Assign List or a Draft List. closeOutOfHoursSession is refused while a List is held. The generator writes AM and PM only. The anaesthetist's setAvailabilityRange refuses an OOH day with no open session ('There is no out-of-hours session open'). The OOH session shows after PM on mobile Forward Lists, the web Lists table, the web Dashboard, mobile and web Find cover, and the availability editor. Marking OOH unavailable with a List goes through holdsListRefusal and the move choice. Admin Find available has an OOH segment, and openSlotViews counts it only when free. The PWA stand-in 'office-adds-out-of-hours-list' exists. Billing has no OOH special case.
items.demo_trigger: Existing: the admin Day grid 'Open out-of-hours session' hover button for the office side, and the PWA stand-in 'office-adds-out-of-hours-list' for the anaesthetist-app view. Nothing further needed.
items.verify_note: I walked every acceptance criterion (opened by the office, same day, none until opened, one a day, own times, availability, Draft List for the evening, marked unavailable while booked, close an empty one) through the domain refusals, store actions and screens. Each is implemented. The button is gated on today or later, so the same-day case works. The 'who may open it when the office is closed' point is a declared open item, not an acceptance criterion.

items.summary: The anaesthetist sets each session's availability (Free by default, holiday, unavailable) on mobile and web. The office reads the same Slot, so changes show at once. Status values are held as master data. OQ-139 is open, but the prototype follows its recommendation of public as a kind of unavailable.
items.requirement_says: From their app an anaesthetist sets the availability of each of their Slots. A Slot is free by default and she changes it, for example to on holiday or unavailable, so the office sees it immediately. Status values start from free, holiday and unavailable, held as master data.

Both use AvailabilityForm (status chips from anaesthetistChoices, AM, PM or both, a repeat series and a note) and AvailabilitySlotPanel (per-session Change or Remove). They write through setAvailabilityRange, createAvailabilitySeries and clearAvailability against the one Slot record the admin Day grid reads. The default status is Free. The seeded statuses are free, holiday and unavailable, as master data with colours. There is no 'Public' status, so it follows the OQ-139 recommendation, and any later value is a master-data edit.

The requirement states no further acceptance criteria.

items.requirement_says: Admins maintain the Slot availability status table directly: a user-maintained list, each status with a fixed internal ID, an editable label and an editable colour. Rules read the ID, not the label. Renaming or recolouring shows everywhere. An added status works with no code change. It is distinct from the List state.

The fields are label, long label, description, colour (one of the design's six tokens), fill treatment, the 'open for bookings' and 'anaesthetists can set' flags and 'default'. Keys are fixed (seeded values, or the next ST####). validateSlotStatusDraft stops labels that name a List state or say 'slot'. Rules use bookable, anaesthetistCanSet and isDefault (isClosed, isOpenSlot), never labels. Display goes through resolveDisplayStatus and the master (StatusChip, legends, Day grid, mobile and web cells), so a rename or recolour shows everywhere. A new status appears in anaesthetist choices and legends with no code. Editing a bookable status to closed is refused while Lists sit on it.

items.summary: Admin and anaesthetists each have a finder across all anaesthetists by day, and OOH is offered when open and free. items.requirement_says: Admins and anaesthetists see AM and PM availability across every anaesthetist for a day, plus the out-of-hours session once opened and free. For admins the free anaesthetists are listed by tier then preferred pairing, sequencing only, never auto-assigning. Anaesthetists see colleagues by availability alone, with no tier or pairing. When moving a Booking or List, a name search filters as letters are typed.
items.prototype_does: Admin 'Find available' (AvailabilityFinderSheet) takes a day and AM, PM or OOH. It uses openSlotViews, so a session holding a List or marked closed is never offered. It has a tier filter, a name type-ahead and a Not preferred group when a surgeon is chosen. Picking a row opens Assign List and assigns nothing. The admin Day grid shows everyone. The web Find cover grid has day navigation, Everyone or Free only (with a count), a name search and an OOH column when anyone has one open. The mobile Find cover has a day strip, Everyone or Free only and free cells, with no tier or pairing. MoveListSheet and MoveBookingToColleagueSheet list colleagues by name with a 'Find a colleague' NameSearchBox. officePrivacy.test.ts keeps tier and pairing out of the anaesthetist apps.
items.verify_note: I re-read the finder sheet and the ranking function. Ordering is tier, then preferred pairing, and nothing is assigned. I confirmed the NameSearchBox in both move sheets and that the anaesthetist apps never call the ranking. OOH is offered only through openSlotViews (free and no List). The web and mobile finders are by name and availability only, so I did not grade this a gap.

items.summary: The anaesthetist's own List move offers colleagues as one flat surname-ordered list by availability alone, with no warning, no preference or tier revealed, and a shared-pool notification to the office.
items.requirement_says: When an anaesthetist moves their own List, no warning or prompt for a not-preferred pairing, neither side learns of any pairing, and colleagues are shown by availability alone (not separated or ordered by preference or tier). The office is notified via the shared pool.

Colleagues come from pushTargets: active colleagues whose same-session slot passes receiveRefusal with requireOpen (so unavailable, on leave or already holding a List are excluded), one flat list sorted by surname, returning only id, name, phone and slotId. The confirm step has no warning of any kind. A 'listMoved' notification goes to the office pool (store/notifications.ts). MovedToYouPanel on the receiver side states nothing about pairing. Pairing and tier code is not imported by apps/mobile, apps/web or the shared move flows; boundary test officePrivacy.test.ts covers it.
items.verify_note: Status Agreed, so re-checked all three criteria (No warning, Nothing revealed, Availability only) against the code: the confirm step has no pairing text, PushTarget cannot carry preference or tier, and the shared/mobile/web sources reference only generic pairing helpers (format, audit labels), none reaching an anaesthetist-visible move flow. The missing type-ahead search belongs to US-01.4.2/01.4.7, not this story's criteria.

items.summary: Owner-only submit and the office's Booking move work, but a prepaid Booking's payable goes to the anaesthetist on the List, not an AA Holding account, so a move leaves it with the wrong person; the anaesthetist-led move to a new List does not exist (status Verify).
items.requirement_says: Whoever submits a List did all its procedures; a Booking done by another anaesthetist is moved to that anaesthetist's List (even a single-Booking List). Unprepaid: payable follows the Booking to the doer. Prepaid: payable is the AA Holding account and does not move, the doer is paid from it at settlement; nothing is recalculated or re-triggered on the move.
items.prototype_does: submitList is owner-only and needs every non-cancelled Booking completed; anaesthetists cannot edit another's List. The office can move one Booking to any non-AUTHORISED List (MoveBookingFlow to reassignBooking), which touches no prepayment or invoice. The Xero handoff derives the ACCPAY payee from the Booking's List's anaesthetist at handoff time, so an unprepaid Booking moved before handoff is paid to the new anaesthetist. A prepayment invoice also hands off at once with a payable to the List's anaesthetist (raisePreProcedureInvoice then handoffCasesForBooking); there is no AA Holding creditor and no settlement transfer, and an already-created accPay keeps its anaesthetistId after a move (code comments mark a 'Phase 41 seam').
missing_or_wrong: No AA Holding payable: a prepaid Booking's ACCPAY is created for the anaesthetist on the List at handoff and never repointed, so after a move A stays the payee and B, who did the work, is not paid from it (contradicts AC 3 and AC 4). The prepayment itself is still the old deposit/self-funded model rather than the Contract-flagged full-amount prepayment of EP-06.
An already-handed-off unprepaid ACCPAY is not repointed when the Booking later moves (payee fixed at handoff).

An anaesthetist cannot move a Booking to a colleague as a new List: reassignBooking refuses anaesthetists unless both Lists are their own (notOwnList), the older reading. Only the office path produces 'Booking ends up on B's List' (see US-01.4.7).

items.requirement_says: Anaesthetists can add a Booking missing from their List by hand (US-02.4.1); photo capture is Future Work (US-02.4.4).
items.prototype_does: 'Add a booking' on the web List detail and mobile List opens AddBookingFlow on the manual form; Booking stamped anaesthetistAdHoc; editRefusal restricts anaesthetists to their own ACTIVE Lists. Photo flow only via the badged 'Photo capture (Future scope)' demo action.
items.verify_note: Feature body states no AC beyond manual add and photo-as-Future; both hold. Caveat for the child story US-02.4.1 (not graded here): ManualBookingForm saves without an NHI, which the NHI-mandatory rule (US-02.1.4) will change; that is tracked under US-02.1.4.
items.title: Anaesthetist ad hoc booking

items.summary: Change types exist as HL7 event handling and are audited with source, but changes apply automatically without pre-apply classification or office approval, and a day move is a reassign rather than cancel plus new Booking. Feature Agreed; OQ-124 open.
items.requirement_says: Every inbound change is classified before it is applied: new Booking, modification (including time change within a List) or cancellation. A day move arrives as a cancellation plus a new Booking. Each change is recorded with its source and history. Applying automatically is Future Work; in release 1 the office reviews and approves.
items.prototype_does: Classification is implicit in the canned event type (S12 new, S13 reschedule, S14 modify, S15 cancel); each lands in audited store actions (booking.create, booking.edit, booking.cancel, booking.reassign) as actor source 'integration', visible in the Booking history and the Audit viewer. All apply immediately. S13 to another day calls reassignBooking (one move).
missing_or_wrong: No pre-apply classification shown to the office; no review or approve before applying
Day move modelled as one reassign, not a cancellation plus a new Booking
No UI states the classification (New, Modification, Cancellation)
No 'what changed' comparison between versions of a List (OQ-124)
items.demo_trigger: Covered by the matching screen demo button (FT-02.1): each incoming row shows a classification chip (New, Modification, Cancellation) before the office approves.
items.verify_note: Status Agreed so re-checked fully: applyEffect applies without any approval, and S13 cross-List uses reassignBooking. Contradicts (implemented behaviour is wrong), not Partial.
items.title: Change types and audit

items.summary: No stub exists, and the no-NHI case the feature is about is handled the opposite way: it becomes a real Booking on a provisional 'NHI pending' patient.
items.requirement_says: When an incoming booking cannot become a Booking (e.g. no NHI), a clearly marked stub stands in its place on the List until the office resolves it from intake, seen by anaesthetists and the office.
items.prototype_does: No stub record or List placeholder. A no-NHI row (message or PDF) creates a provisional patient and a Booking showing 'NHI pending'; a seeded NHI-pending Booking exists; rows that cannot be applied appear only in the Integrations message log.
missing_or_wrong: No Stub record or List placeholder
No stub displayed in Admin, mobile or web Lists
No link from a stub to an intake row
Existing provisional/'NHI pending' Booking is the opposite design (to be removed under OQ-49/OQ-118)
evidence: searched: stub|stubs|mailto in aa-prototype/src (non-test) -> only unrelated 'Phase 10 stub' comments (BillingMonitorScreen.tsx:32, store/selectors.ts:693, store/xeroHandoff.ts:3)
items.demo_trigger: On the matching screen: 'Receive hospital list with a row missing its NHI' - the row waits in the queue and a marked stub appears on the target List in Admin, mobile and web; 'Add NHI' on the row replaces the stub with the Booking.
items.verify_note: Confirmed no stub concept by search. Corrected Missing to Contradicts: the prototype does implement handling for the exact no-NHI scenario, as a provisional NHI-pending Booking, which the catalogue now forbids (a Booking cannot be saved without an NHI). Under the grading rule, wrong implemented behaviour outranks Missing.
items.title: Stubs on a List

items.summary: Hospital bookings are imported only as canned HL7/FHIR messages that become Bookings directly; they never appear as rows on a matching screen (OQ-13 format unresolved).
items.requirement_says: The system imports hospital bookings, however each hospital provides them, so that its rows appear on the matching screen ready to be matched to Lists and Bookings.
items.prototype_does: Simulated HL7 v2 and FHIR messages (feeds stg, cph, sx) are processed via processMessage; each creates or changes a Booking. Rows appear only in the Integrations monitor log, not as unmatched rows for matching. No simulated hospital download for the in-scope priority pathway.
missing_or_wrong: No matching screen to receive imported rows
Import applies to Bookings rather than landing as rows to review
No simulated hospital download or import action for the priority pathway
items.demo_trigger: Button 'Import hospital list' on the matching screen (the FT-02.1 button) that adds a batch of rows with a received time.
items.verify_note: Status Agreed so re-checked. An import path exists but its destination (direct Bookings) differs from the required destination (rows on the matching screen), so Contradicts rather than Missing; Partial is arguable but the auto-apply behaviour is wrong against the current text.
items.title: Import hospital bookings

items.summary: Only the surgeon-PDF review offers a match-or-create decision; it has no reject, Draft List or new-List outcomes, lets a no-NHI row become a Booking with a provisional patient, and overwrites procedure text on update, all against the story.
items.requirement_says: Per imported hospital row the admin can match to an existing List and Booking, create a Booking on an existing List, create a new List in an anaesthetist's Slot, create a Draft List, or reject; a row with no NHI cannot become a Booking and waits in the unmatched queue; procedure text shows exactly as received.
items.prototype_does: PDF tab: facsimile beside editable rows, NHI validated live, choose a target ACTIVE List, 'Already booked on this List, will update' vs create; Ingest row / Ingest all. A blank-NHI row is ingested via createBooking with a provisional patient. Update path overwrites the first procedure's description. Not applied to hospital rows.
missing_or_wrong: No reject option
No create-new-List-in-a-Slot or create-Draft-List outcome from a row
Match only by NHI within the one chosen List, not to an arbitrary existing Booking across Lists
Not applied to hospital rows at all
A no-NHI row creates a provisional-patient Booking instead of waiting (contradicts 'cannot become a Booking')
Update path overwrites procedure text (editProcedure description) rather than keeping it as received
Target picker lists only ACTIVE Lists (no Draft or SUBMITTED)
items.demo_trigger: Matching-screen button 'Receive tomorrow's theatre list' supplies hospital rows; existing 'Ingest PDF row' trigger covers the PDF analogue.
items.verify_note: Regraded Partial to Contradicts: implemented PDF ingest violates two stated rules (no-NHI row becomes a Booking; text overwritten, not as received), not merely missing options. Traced ingestPdfRow: blank NHI skips validation and reaches upsertPatient provisional path.
items.title: Match rows to Lists and Bookings

items.summary: A later hospital update is applied silently, matched by the hospital's appointment id rather than date/surgeon/location/slot; no differences shown, no approval.
items.requirement_says: When a row matches an existing Booking the admin sees field-level differences (time, patient, procedure) and approves; later updates match by date, surgeon, location, slot.
items.prototype_does: S13/S14/S15 find the Booking by correlationRef {feed, appointment id} and immediately editBooking / reassign / cancel as the integration actor; locked or unmatched targets park as manualIntervention in the monitor log. PDF ingest silently overwrites time and operation on NHI match, showing only a 'will update, not duplicate' hint.
missing_or_wrong: No field-level differences view
No approve-update step
Match key is appointment id, not date+surgeon+location+slot
Updates and cancellations auto-applied without admin review
items.demo_trigger: Existing 'Fire hospital message' S13/S14 messages should arrive on the matching screen as a pending 'update' row showing before/after differences with an 'Approve update' button.
items.verify_note: Re-read applyEffect S13/S14/S15 and ingestPdfRow; no diff UI or approve step anywhere. Upheld.
items.title: Show differences on match

items.summary: Unappliable messages park in the technical message log (manualIntervention / dead-letter with Reprocess), but there is no unmatched queue on a matching screen and a no-NHI booking is created as a Booking instead of waiting with a stub.
items.requirement_says: Rows not matched or accepted stay in a queue for manual intervention; an incoming booking with no NHI waits there until the office adds the NHI, creating no Booking, while a stub shows on its List; nothing silently dropped.
items.prototype_does: Messages hitting a locked List, unmatched appointment, missing target List or incomplete pairing park as manualIntervention with a reason and Reprocess in Integrations > Messages (Future-scope badge). Bad-mapping messages retry then dead-letter. A booking with no NHI is accepted: upsertPatient creates a provisional patient and createBooking makes a Booking; PDF review does not block a blank NHI.
missing_or_wrong: No unmatched queue on a matching screen (only the technical message log)
No-NHI incoming booking creates a patient and Booking, contradicting 'no Booking is created until the office adds the NHI'
No stub on the List
No 'add the NHI' resolution action on a waiting row
Queue is message/retry oriented, not row-for-match (match / accept as new / reject)
items.demo_trigger: 'Receive hospital list with a row missing its NHI' on the matching screen: the row sits in the Unmatched queue, no Booking is created, a stub shows on the List; typing an NHI and pressing 'Add NHI' creates the Booking and clears the stub.
items.verify_note: Re-read the cited code; both acceptance criteria fail and the implemented provisional-Booking behaviour is directly opposite.
items.title: Unmatched queue

items.summary: Simulated HL7/FHIR feeds for St George's and Southern Cross exist, but matched messages are applied to Bookings with no admin match/create/reject decision, violating 'No silent apply' (status Proposed; OQ-109 and OQ-13 open).
items.requirement_says: The two integrated hospitals bring rows into the matching screen without a manual download; matching stays manual, nothing is applied until an admin decides, unmatched rows stay in the unmatched queue.
items.prototype_does: FEED-STG (HL7) and FEED-SX (FHIR) plus FEED-CPH (Christchurch Public, deliberately misconfigured) replay canned messages via 'Fire hospital message' or the /demo/integrations simulator; S12 creates the Booking and S13 to S15 modify or cancel it immediately. Unmatched or locked cases park in the message log. No sync button, schedule or last-synced time (correctly absent per the Notes).
missing_or_wrong: Every matched row is applied automatically; no admin match/create/reject (AC 'No silent apply')
Nothing lands on a matching screen; unmatched rows are only a message-log entry
Third feed Christchurch Public is outside the two-hospital scope; Forte vs St George's/Southern Cross unresolved (OQ-109)
Event-per-message simulation rather than a daily list delivery
Demo guide S1 beat 1 presents the auto-created booking as the headline
items.demo_trigger: Button 'Run hospital sync' (St George's / Southern Cross) on the matching screen: simulates the day-before list arriving and drops its rows into the queue unapplied for the admin to match, create or reject.
items.verify_note: Confirmed S12/S13-S15 apply with no admin step. Also confirmed the prototype itself says the in-scope download 'arrives in a later build', so no hidden implementation. Medium confidence because the story is only Proposed.
items.title: Automatic sync from St George's and Southern Cross

items.summary: Correct-before-ingest is met (editable NHI, name, time, operation beside the facsimile, invalid NHI flagged and refused), but there is no upload, no review and merge of differences for a re-sent PDF, and a blank NHI passes through to a provisional Booking.
items.requirement_says: Admins upload an emailed PDF, the system extracts the bookings, the admin can correct any field (e.g. an invalid NHI) before ingest, and a re-sent PDF gives a review and merge step showing what changed to accept.
items.prototype_does: Surgeon PDFs tab: canned inbox, facsimile beside editable rows; invalid NHI flagged red with 'Correct it before ingesting' and ingestPdfRow refuses an invalid NHI; deliberate-error row R3. A row matching a Booking on the target List updates it on the admin's Ingest click with a 'will update, not duplicate' hint and no differences view.
missing_or_wrong: No upload of a PDF (canned inbox only; acceptable as a simulation but no upload control or mailbox read)
No review-and-merge of differences when a later PDF re-sends the List
Blank NHI is ingested into a provisional 'NHI pending' Booking instead of being held at intake
DOB, ethnicity and other extracted fields not editable in review (only NHI, name, time, operation); AC says 'its fields'
items.demo_trigger: Existing 'Ingest PDF row' (registry.ts:515) covers the one-row ingest; add 'Receive updated PDF from rooms' to show the differences and approval.
items.verify_note: The story's own acceptance criterion is satisfied and the admin clicks Ingest per row (nothing is applied silently), so the gaps are things not built (upload, differences, merge) rather than wrong behaviour. The wrong blank-NHI behaviour belongs to US-02.1.4/US-11.1.4 and is listed here as a gap. Regraded Contradicts to Partial; borderline, medium confidence.
items.title: Read, correct and ingest a surgeon PDF list

items.summary: Admin can amend patient, time, procedures (including procedure text) and billing Contract on a Booking, and can create one via phone advice or on a Draft List, but cannot add a Booking to an already-assigned List and has no optional 'as given' source-wording field.
items.requirement_says: Admins create a Booking on a List or amend one (patient, time, procedures, Contract); a phone/email Booking can carry an optional 'as given' procedure text kept as source wording; every change recorded against the admin; all fields editable until authorised.
items.prototype_does: Book (phone advice) on a free session assigns a List then opens AddBookingFlow; Draft List drawer has Add Booking; BookingDetail (office) edits patient, time, BTM, route, governing contract, price override, procedures (EditProcedureSheet edits the Operation text, addProcedure adds one); audit source=office; editable on DRAFT/ACTIVE/SUBMITTED, locked on AUTHORISED.
missing_or_wrong: No Add Booking on an existing assigned List from Admin (SlotDrawer List view has no add control; createBooking callers in admin are only PhoneAdviceBooking and DraftListDrawer)
No optional 'as given' source-wording field on the admin entry form
ManualBookingForm auto-fills operation from the RVG description when blank, so the text kept is not what was told
items.verify_note: Verdict upheld, but two of the reviewer's points were wrong and dropped: procedure text IS editable after creation (EditProcedureSheet Operation field, reachable from BookingDetailBody) and adding a blank procedure is a valid add path. Add-to-assigned-List gap and missing 'as given' field confirmed by grep of createBooking/AddBookingFlow callers in apps/admin.
items.title: Create or amend a Booking

items.summary: Booking edits are written through immediately (per tap or on blur) with one audit entry each; no explicit Save, no unsaved warning, no per-save change set.
items.requirement_says: Admin edits to a Booking apply only when saved; leaving with unsaved edits warns; the system holds the fields changed per save (before/after, who, when) and each save is one history entry the update email can pick.
items.prototype_does: BookingDetailBody commits each change through audited editBooking/editProcedure/editPatient on tap or blur (stepTime, saveNotes). History merges per-field entries and coalesces consecutive single-field edits. No draft state, Save button or unsaved guard (searched beforeunload|unsaved|discard in src: none relevant).
missing_or_wrong: Explicit save absent: edits apply immediately (contradicts 'applied only when the admin saves')
No unsaved-changes warning on leaving the page
No save-level change set; history is per-field/coalesced, not one entry per save
Admin-only rule on a body shared with anaesthetist and mobile surfaces: needs an office-only edit mode so mobile/PWA capture stays write-through
items.verify_note: Grepped again for beforeunload/unsaved: none. Confirmed write-through handlers. Size L right: office-only draft/save mode across Booking, Procedure, patient, billing setup sheets plus change-set storage.
items.title: Save Booking changes explicitly

items.summary: No 'draft update email' button, mailto: composition or change-picker exists; only the data it needs (history sheet, hospital and room contact emails) is present.

missing_or_wrong: No update-email button on Booking detail or Notifications rows
No change picker over the history
No mailto: link, subject/boilerplate, To routing, length limit with 'shortened' note
No 'nothing sent' copy
Depends on change history (US-02.5.5) and the List-move notification offer (US-13.8.2)
evidence: searched: mailto|update email|updateEmail in aa-prototype/src (non-test) -> none; only comment at apps/admin/screens/NotificationsScreen.tsx:19
items.verify_note: Searched mailto, update email, updateEmail, draft email across src: no implementation. The feature is a real on-demand button, so no extra demo trigger is needed.

items.prototype_does: Nothing.
missing_or_wrong: No template entity, admin editor or change-kind mapping

items.summary: Anaesthetists on mobile and web can add a missing Booking by manual entry to their List, but there is no optional 'as given' procedure field kept as source wording.

ManualBookingForm captures NHI, patient, optional RVG, 'Operation', time, billing; createBooking with source anaesthetistAdHoc; audited.
missing_or_wrong: No optional 'as given' field
Single mandatory 'Operation' text, no separate source wording stored on the Procedure
items.verify_note: Verified entry points exist on both mobile and web and the form has no as-given field. Upheld.
items.title: Add a Booking manually

items.summary: One append-only audit trail records who, source, when and before/after for every Booking and Procedure change including Contract selection; the Contract model underneath is still the old governingContractId (EP-04 will rework it).
items.requirement_says: An append-only change log for Bookings and Procedures, including every Contract selection and adjustment, each entry recording its source (a person or an integration), so an invoice can be reproduced as raised.
items.prototype_does: Every mutation goes through mutate(), which throws on zero audit metas and only appends to state.audit (store/mutate.ts:198-249). AuditEntry carries who, role, source, action, before, after, atISO (domain/types.ts:1095). Integration changes are written under an integration actor with source 'integration' (store/integrationActions.ts:46-48). Contract selection is a Procedure field (governingContractId) edited through EditBillingSetupSheet, written as procedure.update with before/after (store/lifecycle.ts:451-475; shared/flows/EditBillingSetupSheet.tsx:112; label in shared/audit/fieldLabels.ts:48). The admin Audit viewer is a read-only feed with entity, source and date filters (apps/admin/screens/AuditViewer.tsx:43-95), and each Booking has a History sheet.
items.verify_note: Re-opened mutate.ts (guard on empty metas, append-only write of state.audit), the AuditEntry type, editProcedure's before/after capture, the Audit viewer filters and the integration actor. Status is Proposed (1), not Agreed. All of the story's rules hold at the history level. Caveat: 'every Contract selection and adjustment' is only met in terms of the old Procedure.governingContractId model; EP-04's flat Contract model will need the history rechecked. The replaced-procedure-text entry belongs to US-02.5.7, not here.
items.title: Append-only change history

items.summary: The prototype lets the office and anaesthetist hand-edit procedure text (forbidden now), and nothing lets the hospital's list or feed text replace the rooms' text with the original kept in the history.
items.requirement_says: The Procedure holds its text as received, starting as the rooms' text; the hospital's list or feed text replaces it with no wording check, the replaced text is kept in the Booking's change history with source and time, nobody edits the text by hand, and a hand-entered Booking keeps what was typed, shown with the Contract and RVG choice.
items.prototype_does: Procedure.description is set once at createBooking from the entered or feed operation (store/bookingActions.ts:136, trimmed). Feed updates S13/S14/S15 never touch it (store/integrationActions.ts:196-232). Any editor with edit rights can change it through the 'Edit operation' sheet (shared/flows/EditProcedureSheet.tsx:51,87 'Operation' text field, opened from shared/booking/BookingDetailBody.tsx:614,725), which writes an audited procedure.update. The S12 hospital create is an interim stand-in for the hospital download (store/integrationActions.ts:169-171). The text appears as a heading on the capture block (shared/capture/BtmCaptureBlock.tsx:134) and on Booking detail (BookingDetailBody.tsx:594), not alongside a Contract and RVG choice as US-03.1.9 describes.
missing_or_wrong: WRONG: hand editing of the procedure text is implemented (EditProcedureSheet 'Operation' field, editProcedure accepts description); the story says nobody edits it by hand.
MISSING: no path where the hospital's list or feed wording replaces the rooms' text, so no history entry showing the rooms' original with the hospital as source and a time.
MISSING: the matching screen (FT-02.1, Phase 33) through which the hospital list reaches a Booking in the first release.
MINOR/arguable: text is trimmed on save (bookingActions.ts:136, EditProcedureSheet.tsx:87), so it is not strictly character for character; low impact.
MISSING: procedure text shown with the Contract and RVG choice (US-03.1.9) is not the current layout.
evidence: searched: stub|unmatched|matching screen|asReceived in aa-prototype/src -> only interim comments about Phase 33
items.demo_trigger: Button 'Apply hospital list update' in the harness Demo actions on the Admin Booking detail (and on the matching screen once Phase 33 exists): applies the hospital's differently worded procedure text as the hospital integration actor, then History shows the rooms' original with source 'Hospital list' and the time.
items.verify_note: Re-read the story, EditProcedureSheet, editProcedure, createBooking and the S13/S14/S15 handlers. Contradicts is right because hand editing of the text is implemented and now explicitly forbidden. The trim point is marginal and flagged as minor, the other points stand. Demo-guide impact: any scripted beat that hand-edits an operation via 'Edit operation' (S1/S4) would change.
items.title: The hospital's procedure text replaces the rooms'

items.summary: Every Booking has a History button on the Booking itself showing when, who, source and field changes, but the office is one hard-coded user (Kirsty W.), and no entry names the hospital's list or shows a replaced procedure text.
items.requirement_says: An admin opens a Booking's change history from the Booking behind a history button; each change shows when, who (the named office user or the hospital system) and what changed. Two office users must each be named; a hospital-list update names the hospital's list as source and shows the procedure text it replaced.
items.prototype_does: BookingDetailBody renders a History button (shared/booking/BookingDetailBody.tsx:441-451) that opens HistorySheet, a newest-first, read-only merged trail of the Booking, its Procedures and billing lines with day headings, 'who · role · source' (shared/booking/HistoryTimeline.tsx:132-136) and old-to-new field changes. It is used by the Admin Booking detail. Feed changes carry the feed's actor label (store/integrationActions.ts:46-48) with source 'integration', so the hospital system is named. The Admin app always acts as the single OFFICE_ACTOR 'Kirsty W.' (store/demoActors.ts:14; apps/admin/AdminApp.tsx:230,303,327).
missing_or_wrong: Admin has one hard-coded office actor, so two office users cannot each be named on their changes (per-user sign-in is US-13.5.1, not built).
No hospital-list update entry that names the hospital's list and shows the replaced procedure text (depends on US-02.5.7).
Correction to reviewer: integration entries do name the hospital feed via actorLabel; only the 'hospital's list' wording and the replaced-text display are missing.
items.demo_trigger: Demo action 'Switch office user' on Admin screens (Kirsty W. / a second office user) so two users' edits show in one Booking's History; plus 'Apply hospital list update' (see US-02.5.7) for the hospital-sourced entry with the replaced text.
items.verify_note: Verdict Partial upheld: the history mechanics and the button on the Booking are present and nothing implemented contradicts the story. Corrected one missing point: integration entries already name the feed (actorLabel), so 'source naming uses feed id' was overstated. Confirmed the single-office-actor gap by reading demoActors.ts and AdminApp.tsx.
items.title: See a Booking's change history

items.summary: No stub exists; a hospital or PDF booking without an NHI is turned into a real Booking with a provisional Patient, the opposite of showing a stub on the List, and other unpostable messages just park in the integration monitor.
items.requirement_says: When an incoming booking for a List cannot become a Booking (for example no NHI), the Scheduling Engine shows a stub in its place on that List, held on an identifier other than the NHI, while the List's other Bookings are added as usual; it is never simply refused.
items.prototype_does: upsertPatient creates a 'provisional' Patient when there is no NHI, so createBooking saves a Booking without an NHI (store/intake.ts:96-120; patient.create audit 'provisional: true'). The seed deliberately holds a provisional no-NHI patient shown as 'NHI pending' (domain/seed/patients.ts:79; shared/format.ts:86). A feed message with no target List, no matched appointment or a locked List parks as manualIntervention in the integration monitor (store/integrationActions.ts:284-295), and a PDF row with an invalid NHI must be corrected before ingest (apps/admin/screens/IntegrationMonitorScreen.tsx:314-323). None of these puts anything on the List.
missing_or_wrong: No stub entity or stub row on a List's Booking list on any screen (admin day/list, web, mobile).
No identifier other than the NHI for an unpostable incoming booking.
A no-NHI incoming booking becomes a real Booking with a provisional Patient, contrary to US-11.1.4 and to the stub rule.
A partly applied download leaves no visible placeholder, so a List can look complete when it is not.
evidence: searched: \bstub\b|unmatched|placeholder booking in aa-prototype/src -> no hits for this concept (only unrelated comments)
items.demo_trigger: Button 'Receive booking with no NHI' in Demo actions on the Admin Day or List view (and the matching screen): delivers a hospital row with no NHI so a stub with its own identifier appears on that List while the other bookings are added normally.
items.verify_note: Contradicts upheld (provisional-Patient Booking is wrong behaviour, not just absent; the seed and S12/PDF path demonstrate it). Corrected surfaces (stubs must also show to the anaesthetist on web/mobile List views) and size M to L: needs a new stub entity, rendering on every List surface, refusing a no-NHI Booking per US-11.1.4, and rework of seed and the PDF pathway. Status Verify; OQ-118 answered by Donald only.

missing_or_wrong: No stub row in mobile and web List views

items.summary: Epic body lists what the anaesthetist does; each bullet is owned by a child feature or story.
items.requirement_says: Anaesthetist sees Lists/Bookings, reads procedures as received, sees and changes Contract and RVG code until AUTHORISED, records billing data, adds pre/post-op events (even after invoicing), changes price where Contract lets, marks Bookings complete.

items.summary: Introduces the schedule/List/Booking views and Contract shown; rules live in US-03.1.x. Status Proposed.

items.title: View schedule, Lists and Bookings

items.summary: A Booking has one primary Procedure (isAdditional false, first by position, not removable) and zero or more additional ones that bill time units only.
items.requirement_says: A Booking has exactly one primary Procedure and zero or more additional Procedures in the same anaesthetic episode.

items.verify_note: Re-read the add/remove code and the Procedure type. The structure rule has no acceptance criteria beyond the sentence and is met. The modifier-split-above-4 rule lives in US-05.3.1, not here.
items.title: Booking structure: primary and additional procedures

items.summary: Capture does not follow the Contract's pricing kind: every Procedure shows and demands the whole ASA, RVG, times, units and modifier form, ASA pre-seeds modifier units, no per-modifier explanation, no events. Status Proposed.
items.requirement_says: On each Procedure the anaesthetist records only what the Contract needs: on an RVG-priced Contract the RVG code, times and modifiers with an explanation each; on a fixed or open price at most an RVG code for reference; plus events. 'Each Procedure carries what its invoice needs, and no more.'
items.prototype_does: BtmCaptureBlock always renders AsaCard, ProcedureCodeCard, TimesCard, UnitsCard (B/T/M), ModifierChips, OverrideCard and BillingLinesCard whatever the Contract. The validator requires start and finish whenever an RVG code is set. ASA seeds modifier units. No modifier note field. No event recording.
missing_or_wrong: Form does not collapse on a fixed or open price (times and modifiers still asked): an implemented older reading, not just a gap (children US-03.3.9, US-03.3.3)
No short explanation per claimed modifier (US-03.3.4)
ASA grade pre-seeds modifier units (US-03.3.4)
Events not recordable (FT-03.7)
The Contract shown is a name in a context line, with no pricing basis (US-03.1.9)

The prototype asks for times and modifiers on fixed-price Contracts and pre-seeds modifiers from ASA, which is wrong behaviour from the older reading, so Contradicts. Reviewer's evidence confirmed.
items.title: Record clinical billing data per Procedure

items.summary: Contract is set only by the office in EditBillingSetupSheet. The anaesthetist cannot change it, and the anaesthetist loses all edit rights at SUBMITTED instead of AUTHORISED. No review flag for anaesthetist changes.
items.requirement_says: The office sets the Contract on each Procedure at booking setup (step rail). The anaesthetist sees it and can change it, with RVG code and (where allowed) price, until the List is AUTHORISED. Every change is audited and seen at review.

EditProcedureSheet edits operation text, billing route, insurer, payment category and reference only. governingContractId is set only in the office EditBillingSetupSheet. The Contract shows to the anaesthetist as a name in the context line.
missing_or_wrong: Anaesthetist cannot change the Contract

items.title: Contract on the Procedure

items.summary: The anaesthetist can override the price on any Contract (fixed-price included) and must give a reason. There is no per-Contract allow flag.

items.verify_note: Confirmed in OverrideCard, fee.ts and the validator.

items.summary: Completion validation names what is missing and blocks List submit; ask-the-office is absent and the validated fields are the old ones.

missing_or_wrong: No ask-the-office alert (US-03.6.3)
What counts as minimum billing data is the old rule set (see US-03.6.1)

items.title: Booking completeness validation

items.summary: No events exist. The only post-op mechanism is the interim 'post-op addendum' (labelled 'Add post-op event'), which creates a new linked Booking on a new List, the opposite of events that live on the Procedure and appear on no List.

It is visible on the Procedure, has an invoice tick box and its own billable party, is billed in the next billing run and appears on no List.
items.prototype_does: addPostOpAddendum makes a NEW Booking (bookingType postOpAddendum) on a new List in the anaesthetist's free session today, inheriting route, insurer and contract, and runs its own capture, submit, authorise and bill cycle. Its code comment says INTERIM until Phase 38b. The demo panel stages it ('Stage post-op scenario'). No event entity, tick box, per-event billable party or next-run bundling.

Pre-op event, credit and refund events not modelled
Open: OQ-12 (ACC codes), OQ-138

items.summary: Base and modifier units anchor to the first Procedure (the one with isAdditional false); additional ones are time-only with the base and modifier fields disabled. No UI to move the primary. OQ-132 option 1 (no base units billed on a fixed-price primary) is what the prototype does.

The first Procedure is not removable. The modifier split above 4 units is not implemented: additional Procedures carry no modifiers at all.

'Copy booking' is separate. Only the office can change a Procedure's governing contract (EditBillingSetupSheet, all contracts, unfiltered).

The validator fails with 'needs a selected unit value between min and max' for an out-of-range base value, which blocks Mark complete. RVG code required regardless of pricing kind

Not driven by a pricing kind
