dataModelDeltas.title: The internal ledger holds both halves of each pair as its own records (including the holding-account payable), posted through a clearing account, with the payable independent of Xero
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Each invoice creates a linked receivable and payable in AA's own ledger, the system of record, which Xero mirrors as ACCREC and draft ACCPAY created together (a prepayment's payable is to the holding account). Control accounts with patient and creditors sub-ledgers, reconciled. New on 10 November (US-08.3.1 technical discussion, AR-63 redrawn): Greg and Sam's proposed posting design routes each invoice and its bill through a clearing account that should always read zero, the bill coming into Xero with the invoice. Proposal only; their process maps and T-accounts will settle the posting design. The trust account is AA's bank account, analysed out into who is due.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: The ledger is the billing slice (Invoice, InvoiceLine, BillingCase with received, authorised, disbursed amounts and Xero ids; types.ts:1328, :1371, :1394). The payable exists only as XeroAccPay in the Xero simulation (types.ts:1497) with '-P' number and, since Phase 22, provisional buyer-created wording. No ledger record for the payable, no control accounts or sub-ledgers, no clearing account, no trust account record.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Promote the Payable into the ledger (payee anaesthetist or holding account) with Xero downstream; split BillingCase into receivable and payable sides; rewire payments, payables run, selectors, Xero view. Model control accounts with patient and creditors sub-ledgers; keep the clearing account as one more account until Greg and Sam's maps settle it; model the trust account as the account receipts land in. Payments are made in Xero and tracked (DM-25). Foundation for DM-21, DM-18, DM-24, DM-23, DM-67, DM-25, DM-29.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Code confirmed: no payable, control account, sub-ledger or clearing record exists; the payable lives only in XeroAccPay. US-08.3.1 is Agreed, the clearing-account design is Proposed. Added the trust account (domain model, Internal ledger) which the draft did not name.

dataModelDeltas.title: Derived ledger positions for the whole ledger, per anaesthetist and per patient; a flat outstanding list without ageing; patient balance alerts
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: The Admin App shows the ledger position for the whole ledger and one anaesthetist, and a patient's outstanding invoices across all anaesthetists (patient-centric even when a guardian pays); the anaesthetist's own outstanding list is flat, oldest first, no ageing buckets or chips (US-12.2.1). A billable patient with a balance raises a warning: mild under the threshold (90 days from invoice date), strong over, mild for a credit balance, always waved through, shown to the anaesthetist too.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Per-anaesthetist outstanding list per ACCPAY with agingDays and buckets (selectors.ts:959 to :975; AccountsScreen), now excluded by US-12.2.1. Boolean patientHasOutstandingPriorEpisode (selectors.ts:608) shown only in the admin Billing Monitor; no threshold or strength; nothing reaches the anaesthetist's List. No whole-ledger, per-anaesthetist or per-patient balance screen, no follow-up record.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Pure selectors over the ledger and three admin views; remove ageing buckets; threshold in appSettings; FollowUpAction record; mild or strong alert on the Booking row in both anaesthetist apps via DM-31. Needs DM-22 and DM-11 (the payer a balance follows is per Procedure).
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Substance upheld. Corrected the attribution: the 'no ageing' rule is US-12.2.1 (the anaesthetist's own unpaid payables list), not the admin ledger views. US-13.2.3 (per-anaesthetist balance) is Retired and is not cited.

dataModelDeltas.title: A reconciliation status derived from the ledger: whether every account that should balance does, with each unresolved item (an unplaced receipt) listed with its amount and age
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: New on 10 November (US-13.2.4, Proposed): the admin dashboard shows one reconciliation status saying whether the books are square: accounts that should read zero (the clearing account), each sub-ledger against its control account, the internal ledger against Xero, and bank lines unmatched in Xero. Beside it, each unresolved item (such as an unplaced receipt) with amount and how long outstanding, so the office and the director approving a payment run can see at a glance. Which accounts it checks follows Greg and Sam's posting design (our reading); where an unplaceable receipt is parked is not settled.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Nothing. The Billing Monitor shows per-case pipeline states and the Xero simulator's matched or unmatched payments, but there is no control account, sub-ledger or clearing account to check (DM-22), no unresolved-item record with an age, no dashboard status.
dataModelDeltas.impact: A derived reconciliation selector over ledger and Xero mirror (never stored), an UnresolvedItem record for an unmatched receipt (age from the demo clock), a dashboard tile and list in Admin, and a demo trigger staging an unplaced receipt. Proposed and dependent on the posting design: build after DM-22 and DM-23 and keep the account list a data table. DM-25's run can read it (our reading of AR-63's balance check).
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: US-13.2.4 exists, status Proposed, and says this. Prototype has no counterpart (grep over src found no reconciliation status or unresolved item).

dataModelDeltas.title: Prepayment: started by picking a prepaid Contract, one prepayment invoice per payer, amount is the Procedure's price when the invoice is raised, invoice generated when an admin approves it (an optional step), prepaid Procedures left off the final invoice with nothing deducted, and a Contract changed off prepaid cancels the prepayment
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Picking a prepaid Contract (Payment type > Prepaid on the step rail; a price-list item or Prepaid · Fixed price with a typed amount) starts the prepayment. A prepaid Contract always bills the Procedure's payer and is never RVG-priced. Amount is the Procedure's price when the invoice is raised, above zero, full, read-only after. Invoice generated when an admin approves (optional step AA can switch off), sent with the letter. New 17 November: prepaid Procedures on one Booking naming different payers each get their own prepayment invoice and each payer is locked once their own is raised. Prepaid Procedures are left off the final invoice, nothing deducted. A Contract changed off prepaid after sent or paid is handled as a cancellation. Only the office moves a Procedure on or off prepaid.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Trigger is an interim read of Contract.prepaid (procedureRequiresPrepayment, invoiceBuild.ts:373); rail offers Prepaid to the office only (contractRail.ts:381). Old lifecycle remains: Procedure.prepaymentDetail full or split (types.ts:847, :970), manual raisePreProcedureInvoice (prepaymentActions.ts:51, no approval or setting), split deposit with balance at the run and a visible deduction line (invoiceBuild.ts:194, :396), full prepayment priced by feeFor, unpaid warning. Payer lock is per Booking (payerActions.ts:40). No letter template or held-for-approval state. Prepayment invoices already group by counterparty ref, so one per distinct payer falls out of DM-11.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Remove PrepaymentDetail, the split path and the netting line; run skips prepaid Procedures but still ranks all. Amount freezes when the invoice is raised (DM-14's typed price, read-only after). Invoice gains a 'held for approval' state under a switchable setting (default on) and a letter-template master. Payer lock becomes per payer (after DM-11). Cancel-on-change needs DM-21's refund and DM-24's credit so lands after them; the rest does not. Before DM-21. Needs DM-14, DM-11.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Code re-read: PrepaymentDetail, raisePreProcedureInvoice (office-only, no approval step), the deduction at the run, the Booking-level payer lock and the office-only Prepaid rail option all as stated. No prepayment letter or approval state exists anywhere in src.

dataModelDeltas.title: AA Holding account: the prepayment's payable is a creditor in the payables sub-ledger, and an accounting move transfers it to the anaesthetist who did the List at authorisation
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: A prepayment's pair pays the AA Holding account: one accounts-payable creditor beside the anaesthetists, not a bank or Xero ledger account, never paid itself. At authorisation a second pair moves the money to whoever did the List (US-06.5.1, now 'an accounting move, not a payment' since 10 November; journals are hard to raise through Xero's API, which is why it is a creditor). Cancelling a prepaid Booking credits and refunds automatically. Open: how Xero posts the move, how the holding bill stays out of the payment run, whether Xero's creditor balance counts prepayments invoiced or only received (AR-63 draws the bill posting with the prepayment invoice).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: No holding account. Soft cancel keeps the Booking, no fee, no credit or refund (cancelBooking, lifecycle.ts:422). The prepayment's ACCPAY is to the anaesthetist and released pro rata as money arrives (payableRelease.ts:16; paymentActions.ts:69), so the anaesthetist can be paid before the procedure.
dataModelDeltas.impact: A ledger creditor record for the holding account as payee; the release rule holds the prepayment payable until authorisation then writes the transfer pair to the List's anaesthetist; cancelling a prepaid Booking calls an automatic credit or refund (DM-24); only system actions move money out; a draft Xero pair to a holding-account contact; balance shown in DM-23. Each payer's own prepayment invoice (DM-20) pairs with its own holding payable. Needs DM-20 and DM-22.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: US-06.5.1 (Verify) and US-06.5.2 to 06.5.4 (Agreed) say this; no holding-account symbol exists in src and cancelBooking charges and credits nothing.

dataModelDeltas.title: Events on a Procedure (pre-op, post-op, billing event, additional invoice, credit, refund) replace the post-op addendum Booking and the other billing lines
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: An event is anything recorded against a Procedure after set up, its own element listed on the Procedure in both apps. Pre-op and post-op events carry own date and time, a time or fixed fee, no other modifiers, an invoice tick and a billable party defaulting to the Procedure's. A billing event is a free-form charge or credit. An invoiced event is billed in the next run, never held for the Procedure's invoice, grouped with the same party's lines where it can. Events are never a List or Slot entry. AA's pre-op consult in its own room (US-03.7.4, Proposed) is open on OQ-138.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: A post-op addendum is a new linked Booking (bookingType 'postOpAddendum', addendumOfBookingId; types.ts:801, :802; addPostOpAddendum, bookingActions.ts:254; 6 non-test files) with its own capture to bill cycle. Late fee lines are BillingLines (billingLineActions.ts:44). No event record, invoice tick, billable-party tick or same-run versus next-run rule.
dataModelDeltas.impact: New Event entity (procedure, kind, date and time, time or fixed fee, invoiced flag, billable party or same-as, invoice link) replacing the addendum Booking and post-invoice billing lines; the run picks events up; one review step; both apps list them. Default billable party is the Procedure's payer (DM-11). After DM-08; DM-18 and DM-24 are event kinds; DM-46's BillingLine removal waits on this.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: US-03.7.1 (Agreed) and the domain model say events are 'not a Procedure added to the Booking'; code has the addendum as a Booking (6 non-test files, count corrected from 4). US-11.2.2 still calls an addendum a Procedure added later: logged as a catalogue contradiction.

dataModelDeltas.title: Additional invoice: a free-form invoice recorded as an event, to any billable party, always an invoice of its own with its own ledger pair
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: An admin (any Procedure) or the anaesthetist (own Procedure) adds a free-form invoice (description, quantity, amount; no Contract rules) to any billable party, traceable both ways to the original, recorded as an event, billed in the next run, always an invoice of its own with its own ledger pair.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Invoice.kind is 'standard'|'prePayment' (types.ts:1338) with bookingId and, since Phase 22, procedureIds (:1344); lineage only for split shares (InvoiceLineage :1316). Priced lines only. No free-form entry, no second-invoice lineage.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Invoice.kind widens (additional, credit note) with originalInvoiceId and procedureId, extending Phase 22's lineage; free-form line entry in both apps; same pair creation and Xero handoff; never joins another invoice. Needs DM-17 and DM-22.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: US-08.6.1, 08.6.3 (Verify) and 08.6.4 (Agreed) match; Invoice.kind has no additional value and lineage has only 'otherShareOfSplit' (types.ts:1317).

dataModelDeltas.title: A wrong invoice is credited in full then rebilled; the payable is reversed by a negative invoice
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: An invoice is never edited, retracted or partly adjusted: credited in full (to any party) and a corrected one raised, each traceable; the ledger payable and Xero pair reverse and re-create together via a negative invoice to the anaesthetist netted in the next payment run (OQ-42); with no later payment it is handled outside (OQ-71). A credit note is not a refund. The accountant agreed on 10 November that credit in full and re-invoice is the way (Greg to test in a demo Xero).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Nothing: no credit note, no negative payable, no rebill; invoices immutable once raised; BillingPipelineStatus has no credited or reversed state (types.ts:1384).
dataModelDeltas.impact: CreditNote entity linked to its invoice, negative payable record and Xero credit mirroring, rebill-from-copy action, new BillingCase states. Needs DM-18 and DM-22; precedes DM-25's netting and DM-21's refund.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: No credit or reversal construct in src; catalogue items are in scope (US-08.6.6 is Proposed).

dataModelDeltas.title: Weekly payment cycle with period approval of BCTIs and a remittance advice that nets negative invoices; the payment is made in Xero and tracked
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: A payable is released when its receivable is paid, for exactly the amount received. Payments run on a weekly cycle with director approval and a remittance advice netting negative invoices; the payment is made in Xero and tracked (OQ-111). On 10 November the accountant wanted more time before payment and Greg proposed Monday to Sunday week, paid Thursday, nothing carried forward; not agreed (OQ-47, Proposed), so the cycle days stay data.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: runPayables (payablesActions.ts:147) pays every authorised-minus-disbursed amount at once under a payablesRunId (Disbursement, types.ts:1634). No cycle, approval, held-out anomalies, remittance advice or netting. Payment is made inside the app: Billing Monitor 'Run payables' (BillingMonitorScreen.tsx:173) and the demo Xero panel's per-payable pay.
dataModelDeltas.impact: PaymentRun entity (week, status, held-out items), approval state on payables, remittance document, netting of negative payables; move the pay action to the Xero simulator and record the disbursement as detected; replace 'Run payables' with the schedule export; bank details (DM-32) held, not used to pay; hold a run while DM-67 is out of balance (our reading); cycle days as settings. Needs DM-24 and DM-22. Proposed, keep replaceable.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Code claims confirmed (runPayables at payablesActions.ts:147, 'Run payables' button at BillingMonitorScreen.tsx:173). US-10.2.7 is Proposed and contradicts the accountant's wish; logged. US-12.1.4 still says bank details are 'used for the payables run', logged as a contradiction with OQ-111.

dataModelDeltas.title: The GST report lists the payments AA passed to the anaesthetist in the month; the anaesthetist's GST period goes
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Each month each anaesthetist gets a list of payments AA passed to them in the month with the GST component of each, for their GST return; payments not invoices; outstanding falls to a later month; downloadable. No GST period on the profile.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: BillingReceipt carries a GST component of amounts received into AA (types.ts:1445; gstComponentOf, paymentActions.ts:34); the web Accounts GST report reads receipts (gstActivityFor, AccountsScreen.tsx:400). Anaesthetist.gstPeriod (types.ts:289, :318) is held and edited (10 non-test files) and defaults the report window.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Re-base the report on payments made to the anaesthetist (payable paid side, DM-22), group by calendar month; remove gstPeriod, seed values and editor. Follows DM-22.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: US-12.1.2 (GST period) is Retired and is cited only as the evidence that the period goes; US-12.2.2 and US-12.1.1 carry the live rule. Report confirmed to read receipts and to default to the anaesthetist's gstPeriod.

dataModelDeltas.title: Audit covers invoices, credit notes, master data and Contract changes but not disbursements, payments or receipts
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: The audit trail covers creates, updates, reassignments, authorisations, invoices, credit notes, master data and Contract and time-entry changes; disbursements, payments and receipts are not audited there (recorded in Xero); depth left open.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Every mutation is audited through mutate() (store/mutate.ts:195) including simulated Xero payments and disbursements (paymentActions.ts 'xero.paymentReceived', payablesActions.ts 'xero.disbursed'); the Audit Viewer lists every entity type with no filter for them (AuditViewer.tsx). Contract, Party, price range, specialty and funding tag edits are audited with before and after (built).
dataModelDeltas.impact: Not a structural gap: the prototype audits a superset. Policy note only: keep audit uniform or filter payment and disbursement entries from the viewer. Credit notes (DM-24) must be audited.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Kept as a policy note rather than dropped: the audit viewer does show the simulated payment and disbursement entries, so the catalogue difference is real but small. It is not a data-model change; do not let it displace structural work.

dataModelDeltas.title: The NHI is mandatory with no blank: a Booking cannot be saved without one, and an incoming row without one waits at intake
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Every patient record has an NHI from creation, no blank or pending state; the NHI is the identifier and dedupe key. A Booking cannot be saved without one. An incoming booking with none waits in the matching screen's unmatched queue and a stub stands in its place on its List (DM-58, OQ-118). Search by NHI or name.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Patient.nhi optional (types.ts:204); upsertPatient creates a 'createdProvisional' record when none (intake.ts:30, :128); UI prints 'NHI pending' (shared/format.ts:56). Dual-format validation and hidden internal ID are fine. No waiting-row queue, no save guard.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Patient.nhi required; remove provisional path and 'NHI pending' (14 non-test files); creation paths refuse or park a row without one; waiting rows live in DM-34's unmatched queue each drawing a stub (DM-58); search by NHI or name; check seed patients for blanks.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: US-11.1.1 (Agreed) says mandatory; US-11.1.4 and US-11.1.5 are Verify. Code confirmed (optional field, createdProvisional outcome, 'NHI pending' badge). File count corrected from 16 to 14.

dataModelDeltas.title: Hospital booking downloads and the rooms' PDF lists land on a matching screen as import rows with an admin decision; unmatched rows and rows with no NHI wait in a queue
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: First release builds both intake sources on one review-and-merge screen (OQ-108, Donald, for the build): hospital downloads and the rooms' PDF lists. No pull buttons or schedules; nothing applied silently: the office accepts unmatched rows as new and approves differences on matched Bookings; unmatched and no-NHI rows wait in a queue. Syncs the two integrated hospitals (OQ-109, which two is open). More feeds, automatic matching, HL7/FHIR are Future Work.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Unchanged. Simulated HL7/FHIR messages applied straight to Bookings by processMessage (integrationActions.ts:373) with an IntegrationMessage log (types.ts:1667); ingestPdfRow (integrationActions.ts:498) ingests a canned PDF row straight onto a List. Gated only by List state (lifecycle.ts:60). 'hospitalRow' reserved as a Draft List origin (types.ts:627), nothing emits it. No import row, match decision, difference view or unmatched queue.
dataModelDeltas.impact: New ImportRow and MatchDecision entities and a queue screen; feed Booking writes move behind approval; HL7/FHIR log demoted or becomes the row source. One row shape for both sources (source, text as received, link to message or PDF, DM-61). Both ingest paths move behind the decision. DM-51 (built) supplies text as received; needs DM-30; DM-61 supplies PDF rows, DM-58 the stub.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: US-02.1.1 to 02.1.3 are Agreed; FT-14.6 and the Future Work stories (US-02.2.3, US-02.5.x) are cited only as the boundary. Code confirmed: both ingest paths write straight to Bookings and nothing emits 'hospitalRow'.

dataModelDeltas.title: A stub stands in a List for an incoming booking that could not be posted, held on an identifier other than the NHI
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: When an incoming booking cannot become a Booking (for example no NHI), a stub shows in its place on that List and the List's other Bookings are added as usual; held on an identifier other than the NHI as a separate record, not a Booking (OQ-118; that the Booking then replaces the stub is our reading).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Nothing. A row without an NHI becomes a Booking on a provisional patient (intake.ts:128) printed 'NHI pending' (shared/format.ts:56); no stub, placeholder or intake queue, so a List missing a booking looks complete.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Stub record on the List (id, List, source row reference, reason, text as received) outside the Bookings table, drawn in both anaesthetist apps and Admin with a problem mark, replaced by the Booking on resolution. Needs DM-30; rows come from DM-34's queue (the processMessage path can create it earlier). Seed one demo List with a stub; PERSIST_VERSION bump.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: FT-02.6 and US-02.6.1 to 02.6.3 are Verify; grep finds no stub construct in src.

dataModelDeltas.title: A surgeon's PDF list is a source document: an inbox of emailed lists, rows read from it, corrected before ingest, landing on the matching screen
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Admins upload an emailed PDF list of a surgeon's bookings; the system extracts rows for review before ingest; the admin can correct fields such as an invalid NHI first. The PDF is a source document the Booking links back to; a re-sent List merges through the matching screen.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Demo-only inbox: SurgeonPdf and PdfRow fixtures (pdfSamples.ts:16, :31) with a facsimile and a deliberately wrong NHI, shown in the Integration Monitor PDF tab with edit-then-ingest. ingestPdfRow (integrationActions.ts:498) validates the NHI and updates or creates a Booking with source 'surgeonPdf' at once. Fixtures outside the store: no stored document, upload, sender or received date, row status, link back, or merge of a re-sent List.
dataModelDeltas.impact: SurgeonPdfList record (file or facsimile, sender, received time, target List suggestion, status, extracted rows with corrections) with an admin upload action replacing fixtures; rows become DM-34 import rows with the rooms as source, direct ingest goes, re-sent Lists show differences; NHI correction moves to the matching screen. Simulated parsing stays. Built with DM-34; seed the inbox as stored records (PERSIST_VERSION bump).
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: US-02.2.1 left Future Work on 4 November (status Verify, no swimlane); US-02.2.2 (edit then ingest) is Retired and not cited. Fixtures confirmed outside the store.

dataModelDeltas.title: Explicit-save change sets, an on-demand update email draft picked from the change history, and email templates
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: An admin saves Booking edits explicitly (unsaved-changes warning); each save records fields changed (before, after, who, when) in the append-only history. A Booking has an on-demand 'draft update email' button: pick changes, a mailto opens prefilled (hospital contact for a cover change, surgeon's room for a Booking change); the system sends nothing. Proposed: configurable templates per kind of change. The per-Booking history screen with named office users is US-02.5.8.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Append-only audit per mutation (AuditEntry types.ts:1258, mutate.ts:195), not grouped into save sets; edits apply immediately (editBooking, lifecycle.ts:476); no email draft or templates. Contact emails exist. History view exists (HistorySheet, HistoryTimeline in all three apps, including replaced procedure text). The office is one fixed actor (OFFICE_ACTOR 'Kirsty W.', demoActors.ts:14), so no named office user.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Change-set grouping on audit entries (or a draft buffer), email-draft launcher, template master; admin edit form becomes explicit-save. Launched from the notification pool (DM-41, built). For a surgeon at several rooms (DM-60) the To address is OQ-127 part 5. US-02.5.8 needs no new store, only named office users (a demo persona matter).
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: US-02.3.2 and 02.3.4 are Agreed, 02.3.3 Verify; US-02.3.5 (send automatically) is Future Work and not cited. Code confirmed: edits apply immediately, no email draft, one fixed OFFICE_ACTOR.

dataModelDeltas.title: A session may be split into an A and a B List, one surgeon each (Proposed): the one List per Slot rule gains its first exception
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: An admin can split an anaesthetist's AM or PM session into an A and a B List when two surgeons share it; each List has its own surgeon and follows the one-surgeon, one-hospital rule; at most two (US-01.1.5, Proposed, not agreed by AA; unchanged since the last pass).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: A Slot holds at most one List by construction: a List names its Slot via slotId (types.ts:726 to :731) and the Slot stores no List list (types.ts:589); answeringLists (draftLists.ts) keeps one per day and session. Out-of-hours (DM-66, built) adds a third session but keeps one List per Slot. No A or B label.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Do not build until agreed. If agreed, Slot to List becomes one to one-or-two with an A or B label; grid, generation, recurring painting, availability and move paths, conflicts, colleague finder and out-of-hours all assume one List per session. 63 non-test files read Session. Independent of pricing.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: US-01.1.5 is Proposed (status 1), in scope but explicitly not agreed; the domain model keeps 'holds at most one' until agreed. Left on the list as a do-not-start item.

dataModelDeltas.title: The anaesthetist profile holds mandatory bank account details and a mandatory HPI CPN (the rest of the master data is built)
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: The profile holds contact details, registration number, HPI CPN, bank account details held in the system, and the unit rate (the only billing setting); no GST period or prepaid setting. Bank details and the HPI CPN are mandatory (US-12.1.4 criterion). The GST number (US-08.4.5, built as an optional Admin-only field) waits on OQ-29. US-12.1.4 still says the bank details are used for the payables run, which OQ-111 (Xero pays) overtakes.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Anaesthetist (types.ts:283) holds contact, unit value, GST period, HPI CPN (hpiId typed string documented optional, so blank accepted; types.ts:296), start date, active, optional Admin-only gstNumber (:315). No bank details. Surgeons, rooms, groups and hospital contact email are built.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Bank account field set on Anaesthetist, required-field guard on HPI CPN and bank details in the Master Data form and store action, seed values; master data only, not paid from (DM-25). Low risk, any time.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: US-12.1.4 (Agreed) states both are mandatory and refused if blank (Greg 28 Oct, Donald 29 Oct); US-12.1.5 (bank details for disbursement) is Retired and merged into it. Code confirmed. Contradiction with OQ-111 about who uses the bank details added to the contradictions list.

dataModelDeltas.title: Reference data: a master public-holiday calendar and a repeatable one-off data load (the maintenance screens for the new masters are built)
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Admins maintain all reference data in one place (hospitals, surgeons with specialties, groups, rooms, anaesthetists, slot statuses, recurring bookings, the master public-holiday calendar and each hospital's own, RVG groups, modifiers, specialties, funding tags, Parties, Contracts with price ranges), each change audited. A one-off data load seeds the system at cutover (US-13.4.3).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Master Data has CRUD for hospitals, anaesthetists, surgeons, rooms, statuses, recurring bookings, holidays, Parties, Contracts with price ranges, specialties, funding tags, RVG groups and modifiers (apps/admin/screens/masters/*). The RVG time rule is data but its editor is Phase 42's. Missing: holidays are per hospital only (HospitalHoliday, types.ts:1163), no master calendar; seeds are TypeScript fixtures with no repeatable load (specialist directory is a generated fixture, OQ-129).
dataModelDeltas.impact: Master public-holiday calendar feeding each hospital's, an RVG time rule editor, optionally a repeatable load script. The entity maintenance screens that were most of this delta landed with their entities.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: US-13.4.1 lists the master (public holiday) calendar beside each hospital's; US-13.4.3 is Proposed; bulk Contract upload (US-04.2.13) is Future Work and not cited. HospitalHoliday is per hospital with no master calendar.

dataModelDeltas.title: Warning routine: the model, the dashboard to-do list and most rules are built; the balance rule and the per-Procedure child-payer finding remain
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: One routine raises warnings (before or after procedure, mild or strong, never blocking): unpaid prepayment, billable patient with a balance, a child left as a Procedure's payer (per Procedure, one to-do per Booking, 17 November), base units outside the RVG range, an insured Booking with no approval number (insurer only). Office-review flags (Contract changed by the anaesthetist, typed price on a non-open Contract, Needs an invoice destination or price) are derived, not warnings; a Disabled Contract on an open Procedure may join them (OQ-135).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Built (Phases 15a, 21, 22): Warning, WarningRule, WarningClearance, five rules (prepaymentUnpaid, baseUnitsOutsideGuide, childPayer, approvalNumberMissing, splitDoesNotFit; warnings/types.ts:20), stored clearance, dashboard to-do list, Booking flag; review flags in reviewFlags.ts. The model takes per-Procedure findings (warnings/types.ts:57) but childPayer emits one Booking-level finding.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Two rules remain: billable-patient-with-a-balance (DM-23) and childPayer moving to per-Procedure findings with a one-per-Booking dashboard fold (with DM-11). The dashboard tick also resolves notices (DM-41, built).
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: childPayer.ts confirmed to emit one Booking-level finding via childPayerOn; five registered rules and the contractNoLongerFits and payerContactMissing review flags confirmed. US-13.7.4 (settings) is Future Work and not cited.

dataModelDeltas.title: The surgeons' room master tolerates a missing email, a surgeon belongs to one or more rooms, and rooms gain practice manager and PA contacts (where they belong is open)
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: A surgeons' room is master data holding its contacts; a surgeon belongs to one or more rooms (OQ-128, Donald, for the build). A room may lack email or phone; practice manager and PA contacts have no settled home (OQ-127, OQ-126); which room's email is the To address for a multi-room surgeon is OQ-127 part 5.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: SurgeonRoom (types.ts:364) with required contactEmail and a phone; room form refuses an empty or implausible email (surgeonActions.ts:125 to :132), blank phone accepted. Surgeon (types.ts:341) has required specialtyIds (DM-63 built), one required roomId (:351; 11 non-test files), required hpiId. No contact list, PA or practice manager, surgeon email. Directory seed loads 40 rooms and 131 surgeons with reception@ placeholder emails and the smaller practice for the four two-practice surgeons.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Optional email (draft-email launcher tolerates empty To); Surgeon.roomId becomes a list (surgeon form, profile, rooms view, audit labels, seed, derived room-to-surgeons lookup; directory seed loads the four two-practice surgeons at both rooms; PERSIST_VERSION bump). A contacts list (name, email, role, owner) is the only new entity and waits on OQ-127: build optional email and many rooms, hold the list. Independent of other deltas.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Domain model ('a surgeon belongs to one or more rooms') and US-13.6.1 to 13.6.2 match; US-13.6.5 (contacts) is Open (status 2) so only the optional email and many rooms are buildable. Seed header confirms one room per surgeon and reception@ placeholders; the 40 and 131 counts were not recounted.

dataModelDeltas.title: The Procedure's hospital contract or approval reference and its completeness prompt have no catalogue home: holder-required references are dropped for now (open on OQ-136)
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: A Contract names no references its holder needs: Donald's Contract settings have no such setting, so for now the Booking keeps only the insurer approval number (US-11.4.3; OQ-136, Proposed: drop them for good, or add a Contract setting later that makes the Booking ask for them). The holder's invoice layout carries the BTM breakdown, 'a couple more fields so a hospital can cross-match' (US-08.4.1, which does not name them) and the Contract's holder reference code (US-04.2.18). The earlier 'Required booking inputs' story (US-04.2.7) is Retired. No Procedure field holds a hospital reference.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Procedure.billingReference ('the hospital's contract/approval reference', types.ts:972; 15 non-test files: seeds, ManualBookingForm, PhoneAdviceBooking, EditBillingSetupSheet, OfficeBillingSetup). billingReferenceMissing (validateBookingForBilling.ts:73) says a hospital, surgeon or surgeon-group holder 'expects' one and the office billing setup prompts for it (OfficeBillingSetup.tsx:36); the holder layout prints it as the cross-match hospital reference (invoiceBuild.ts:333, Invoice.crossMatch.hospitalRef, types.ts:1325). The code comment records that Phase 21 builds no other holder reference (OQ-136, D82).
dataModelDeltas.impact: Hold: do not remove until OQ-136 is answered. If references are dropped, the field, its capture in three forms, the 'reference missing' prompt and the hospitalRef cross-match field go (the Contract's holder reference code stays; the cross-match fields are then the procedure date and surgeon until US-08.4.1 names more). If a Contract setting is added instead, the reference becomes a Contract-driven Booking input rather than a fixed Procedure field. Seed bookings carry it, so removal needs a PERSIST_VERSION bump. Independent of the other deltas.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Missed by the author. Found by walking the Procedure type against the domain model: billingReference has no counterpart, the catalogue says the Booking keeps only the approval number, and OQ-136 (Proposed) is the open question. Small and held, not urgent.

deltaSummary:
Verified all 28 draft deltas against the catalogue and code, added one (DM-68), dropped none, and updated /Users/d.fraser/Development/Stratos Dev/AnaesthesiaAssociatesRFP/docs/prototype-build/catch-up/analysis/domain-model-delta.md to match (29 open deltas; index, summary counts, suggested order, contradictions list, a new DM-68 section and an "Adversarial verification" paragraph).

Corrected (5): DM-14 (the draft said a typed priceOverride survives a Contract change; applyContractChange clears it, contractRail.ts:483, only the release-Contract path leaves it); DM-46 (OQ-89 is about Contract time bands, not "time optional", and DM-28 is only partly open); DM-08 (authoriseList already requires completed Bookings, which need a price, and an empty authoriseBlockersFor seam exists at lifecycle.ts:363; the snapshot is the real gap); DM-50 (typed-price line reference moved to fee.ts:307); DM-23 (the no-ageing rule is US-12.2.1, the anaesthetist's list). Smaller count fixes: DM-11 payer readers 22 not 19, DM-17 addendum files 6 not 4, DM-30 files 14 not 16.

Upheld with notes: DM-11 (added the addendum wording tension), DM-22 (the trust account, which the domain model names and the draft did not), DM-32 and DM-25 (US-12.1.4 says bank details are used for the payables run, which OQ-111 overtakes), DM-45 (kept as a policy note: the audit viewer does list simulated payment entries, but it is not a structural gap).

Added: DM-68 (RemovedEntity, S, held on OQ-136), Procedure.billingReference, billingReferenceMissing and the cross-match hospitalRef, which the catalogue no longer has (the Booking keeps only the insurer approval number).

Scope check: of all items cited, only US-03.3.6, US-03.3.7, US-04.2.4 and US-12.1.2 are Retired (used as boundary or removal evidence only) and no in-scope claim rests on a Future Work item (FT-14.6 is a boundary in DM-34). Two catalogue contradictions logged: bank details used for the payables run versus Xero paying (OQ-111), and a post-op addendum as an added Procedure (US-11.2.2) versus an event (FT-03.7). I found no other structural gap: the contract model, parties, specialties, funding tags, price ranges, notification pool, move paths, out-of-hours, unavailability and NHI lookup match the code.

reverseFindings.title: Attachments on Bookings and Lists are fully built
reverseFindings.explanation: US-03.1.3 was Retired 16 Oct (no requirement; Ben does not want the rooms' PDFs on a Booking). The prototype still lets the anaesthetist attach photos or files to any Booking and List on mobile and web, the office sees List attachments, and a theatre-list PDF is seeded and touched by S1.
reverseFindings.verify_note: Code lines re-read. No live story mentions attachments (only US-02.3.3's mailto limit); US-02.4.4 is photo-to-Booking, Future Work, a different thing.

reverseFindings.title: GST period is a per-anaesthetist setting and a report selector
reverseFindings.explanation: US-12.1.2 Retired 16 Oct: no GST period on the profile; the GST report is monthly. The prototype stores monthly, bi-monthly or six-monthly per anaesthetist, asks for it on add and edit, seeds one six-monthly anaesthetist (Dr Whitaker) and offers a three-way period switch on the web report.
reverseFindings.verify_note: US-12.1.2 notes confirm ('way too complicated'); US-12.2.2 says monthly. periodWindow and Segmented switch confirmed in AccountsScreen.

reverseFindings.title: Rate x time billing line and the Method 3 individual-arrangement gate
reverseFindings.explanation: US-03.3.7 merged into US-03.3.6, itself Retired into events (FT-03.7); US-03.3.6's notes say the unit x rate billing line is removed. A Contract at its own rate prices the whole Procedure at BTM units x rate with no line (US-05.2.6). The prototype still offers hours x hourly rate gated by permitsIndividualArrangement, with a seeded hourly Contract. Fixed ancillary lines can stay until events are built.
reverseFindings.verify_note: Gate, flag and seeded Aria hourly Contract re-read. Strongest evidence: US-03.3.6 notes state the line was removed (OQ-89).

reverseFindings.title: Price adjustment: mandatory reason, offered on every Contract, no per-Contract flag
reverseFindings.explanation: US-03.5.1 says no reason is needed (audited, flagged at review) and, since 5 Nov, the override is a per-Contract setting existing only on RVG-priced Contracts, never on fixed or prepaid prices; the anaesthetist types an amount only on No contract Fixed price. The office also needs no reason (US-05.4.2). The prototype demands a reason from both, offers $ adjustment and fixed charge on every Contract, and has no flag.
reverseFindings.verify_note: US-03.5.1 and US-05.4.2 read: both say no reason is needed. validator 'Give a reason' confirmed.

reverseFindings.title: Prepayment is a per-Booking payment category with split deposit or estimated fee, netted from the final invoice, no settlement on cancel
reverseFindings.explanation: Live model: per-Procedure prepayment triggered by picking a prepaid Contract on the step rail; always the full fixed amount above zero, billing the payer, read-only once invoiced, generated on an optional admin approval; the prepaid Procedure is left off the final invoice (no deduction, no balance); cancel credits or refunds automatically; leaving a prepaid Contract after sending is handled as a cancellation. The prototype keys on route plus a Pre-payment category, offers full (BTM estimate) or split (deposit), raises the invoice by office button with no approval, deducts the deposit and bills the balance, fails a Booking when prepayment exceeds the fee, and settles nothing on cancel (buildPrePaymentInvoiceForBooking returns nothing on cancel). The unpaid-prepayment warning is correct.
reverseFindings.verify_note: US-06.2.1, 06.3.1, 06.3.7, 06.4.1, 06.5.2 read and each contradicts the cited code (deposit/estimate lines, 'Less pre-payment deposit', negativeTotal).

reverseFindings.title: Protected default Type 1 Contract per hospital and direct-claim insurer, auto-created and used as fallback
reverseFindings.explanation: FT-04.4 and US-04.4.1 stay Retired. The one built-in is No contract RVG billed to the payer (US-04.3.3); since 5 Nov each destination also gets one system-made open-price fallback (typed amount, never RVG-priced) once it has an Active Contract (US-04.3.9). The prototype mints an RVG-priced protected default with every hospital and direct-claim insurer, forbids deleting or end-dating it, and falls expired Contracts back to the List hospital's default.
reverseFindings.verify_note: US-04.3.3 and US-04.3.9 read; protected-default message, isDefault seed and defaultContractFor confirmed.

reverseFindings.title: Contract price rows (Contract lines) with second-procedure pricing keyed on procedure ordinal
reverseFindings.explanation: US-04.2.4 (Contract lines) Retired 5 Nov: each priced item is its own Contract, fixed prices change through dated price ranges. US-04.2.5 and US-05.3.4 Retired 5 Oct: Contracts do not define second-procedure pricing. The prototype's Type 3 Contract is a header with ContractPrice rows keyed on RVG code, surgeon and ordinal, prices an add-on only from an ordinal row, and seeds a $950 second-procedure price (CP-BAR-3).
reverseFindings.verify_note: Retirement notes of US-04.2.5 and US-05.3.4 read verbatim; ContractPrice.procedureOrdinal and the seed row confirmed.

reverseFindings.title: The above-four modifier split is missing; additional procedures can never hold a modifier share
reverseFindings.explanation: Retired into US-05.3.1: base units on the primary only, time units on every Procedure, modifier units wholly on the primary while the Booking total is 4 or fewer, then split equally across RVG-priced Procedures with the remainder to the primary. The prototype's splitBillingUnits is the original RFP rule (additional procedure yields time units only), locks B and M, and has no split. Narrowed on verification: for a total of four or fewer the prototype matches the live rule; the defect is the above-four case, where all modifier units stay on the primary.
reverseFindings.verify_note: Draft overstated: locking M on additional procedures is consistent with US-05.3.1 when the total is 4 or fewer. Only the above-four split (7 over 3 = 3/2/2) is wrong. Title and explanation narrowed; kept as a defect, not only a gap.

reverseFindings.title: P1 absorbed by the wrong codes and struck through instead of shown selected at 0 units
reverseFindings.explanation: US-05.2.3 was Retired ('a base code never absorbs a modifier'), but US-05.1.4 and US-03.3.4 restore the idea in a different form: P1 is already included in the six Neurosurgery codes (H7A to H9b) and fourteen Spine codes (S1 to S10 and sub-codes) and shows selected at 0 units, not locked (US-03.3.4 says it cannot be unselected; US-05.1.4 says it can be turned off, an internal wobble). The prototype marks seven demo codes (five hip and shoulder, not in the RVG list) as absorbing P1, has no Neurosurgery codes, refuses the add with a message, and shows an inert struck-through chip.
reverseFindings.verify_note: US-05.1.4 and US-03.3.4 read; seven absorbsModifierCodes P1 entries confirmed (47516, 47519, 47522, 48900, 48939, 51011, 51020); ModifierChips comment confirms 'inert and struck through'.

reverseFindings.title: Ranged base code must be chosen inside the published range before a Booking can be completed
reverseFindings.explanation: Retired into US-03.3.1: the anaesthetist is shown the range and may enter any base units, including outside it; an out-of-range value raises an after-procedure office warning and never blocks. The prototype's range chooser (RangeUnitsRow) is clamped to the range and completion is refused unless a selected base value in range exists; the main B stepper is not clamped, and no out-of-range office warning is raised.
reverseFindings.verify_note: Draft said the stepper is clamped; only the range chooser is. UnitsCard stepper uses Math.max(0, ...). The real defects are the completion refusal and the missing office warning. Title and explanation corrected.

reverseFindings.title: Engine re-resolves Contract and payer at billing time; nothing snapshotted at AUTHORISED
reverseFindings.explanation: US-08.1.1 (from retired US-08.1.2): the engine works out no route or payer; it reads the Contract locked to each Procedure, snapshotted at AUTHORISED (US-04.3.5, Agreed). The prototype's stored Contract governs only while in effect on the List date, else it falls back or resolves by route; the payer is derived; no snapshot exists anywhere in the code, so later master edits or Resolve and retry change a re-run. Overlaps RV-06, RV-18 and RV-32 (one rework family).
reverseFindings.verify_note: resolveContractForProcedure and counterpartyForProcedure re-read; grep for snapshot finds no pricing snapshot. US-08.1.1 is only Proposed but US-04.3.5 and US-07.3.1 are Agreed.

reverseFindings.title: Insurer master with accepts-direct-claims flag, an Insurer route gated on it, and delivery hard-wired by insurer
reverseFindings.explanation: FT-11.4 and US-11.4.1 Retired 28 Oct: no insurer master, no direct-claims flag. An insurer is a kind of Party with billing name and email or post delivery (US-04.1.5); whether it is invoiced is a setting of each Contract; the Booking's insurer only suggests a path (US-04.3.10). The prototype has the Insurer master and flag (flipping it mints a default Type 1), an Insurer route gated on it, '(direct claims)' labels, and delivery hard-wired to the insurer kind (refuses email, 'Upload portal'). The nib-invoiced outcome is reachable through a Party and can stay. No approval-number warning exists (a gap).
reverseFindings.verify_note: FT-11.4 note quoted ('We don't have a master insurance list'); validator, flip button, uploadPortal refusal and InvoiceDocument branch confirmed.

reverseFindings.title: Automated modify, reschedule and cancel from hospital messages shown working, with a day move applied as a cross-List move
reverseFindings.explanation: All on the Future Work swimlane. Canned S13 to S15 messages are applied by an integration actor with no admin. US-02.5.2 says a List never moves day (a day move is a cancel plus a new Booking), contradicted by the S13 cross-List reassignBooking; US-02.5.4 wants inbound changes accepted until AUTHORISED (the prototype refuses once SUBMITTED, lifecycle.ts:57-62); US-02.5.3 says a cancelled prepaid Booking settles its prepayment (S15 settles nothing). Demo actions and the Messages tab are already badged Future, so the issue is the behaviour shown.
reverseFindings.verify_note: US-02.5.2, 02.5.3, 02.5.4 read; cross-List move code and the 'integration update cannot change a submitted List' refusal confirmed.

reverseFindings.title: HL7 v2 to FHIR simulator, live drip, and Scenario S1 built on them
reverseFindings.explanation: HL7, FHIR and near-real-time are Future; first release is sync from the two integrated hospitals (St George's, Southern Cross) plus the rooms' PDF lists into one matching screen (US-02.1.5). Tabs and demo actions are badged and S1 labels its beat a Future illustration, but the Integrations page intro (unbadged) says HL7 is translated to FHIR and applied, the simulator offers a live feed with raw HL7, and S1 still opens on a pushed message creating a Booking.
reverseFindings.verify_note: Intro paragraph, live-drip timer and S1 blurb read. Mostly mitigated by badges already, hence small.

reverseFindings.title: Reliability tooling (retries, dead-letter, manual intervention): unbadged nav badge and patient names in the log
reverseFindings.explanation: Future. The prototype retries three times (MAX_ATTEMPTS), dead-letters, shows an amber nav badge, offers Reprocess and lists the patient name on every log row where US-14.5.1 wants a restricted view. The Messages tab is already badged; only the nav badge and Patient column remain and fall away when the tab is demoted.
reverseFindings.verify_note: Nav badge comment, Reprocess button and Patient column confirmed. Low severity, correctly 'keep as scaffold'.

reverseFindings.title: Further hospital feeds and automatic application with no matching step
reverseFindings.explanation: Further feeds and automatic matching are Future; US-02.1.5 keeps a manual matching review ('nothing is applied until an admin decides'), an unmatched queue and stubs, and only St George's and Southern Cross are in scope. The prototype has three feeds (one for Christchurch Public, not integrated) and creates Bookings straight onto Lists with no review queue, last-synced display or unmatched queue. The gap is the missing matching screen; applyEffect is already commented as interim.
reverseFindings.verify_note: US-02.1.5 text read ('No silent apply', only the two hospitals); three FEED entries confirmed.

reverseFindings.title: Billing route plus Type 1/2/3 Contracts instead of one Contract per Procedure on the step rail
reverseFindings.explanation: Supersedes the Phase 08 route and governing-Contract rulings and the 7th-review billing-route rulings. Each Procedure has exactly one Contract held by a Party, saying whether it bills its holder or the payer, its pricing kind and whether it is prepaid; no Contract kinds. Office and anaesthetist share the step rail (US-04.3.8, 10 Nov); a Booking cannot complete without a Contract (US-04.3.1, Agreed). The prototype uses a per-Procedure route (Contract holder, Billable party, Insurer), Type 1/2/3 with holder types and scope, an office-only setup sheet, a payment category that drives funding, and completion that needs a route. Donald's 5 Nov decisions (Verify), not yet confirmed by AA or Greg; keep as a labelled simplification until the rework.
reverseFindings.verify_note: US-04.2.1, 04.2.2, 04.3.1, 04.3.8, 03.4.1 read; all consistent with the draft. Umbrella finding for RV-06, RV-07, RV-11, RV-21, RV-30, RV-32, RV-39.

reverseFindings.title: The anaesthetist's edit rights end at SUBMITTED
reverseFindings.explanation: Supersedes binding convention 6 and the Phase 03/07 guards. US-07.2.1 (Agreed): the anaesthetist can edit a submitted List until the office AUTHORISES it; last edit stands. The prototype refuses any anaesthetist write once SUBMITTED ('Only the office can change it now'), hides every edit control, and the submit sheet tells her she cannot change Bookings afterwards.
reverseFindings.verify_note: US-07.2.1 and US-02.5.4 read; lifecycle refusal and submit-sheet copy confirmed verbatim.

reverseFindings.title: A patient without an NHI is allowed (provisional record, NHI pending); no stub on the List
reverseFindings.explanation: Supersedes the Phase 03/10 provisional-patient rulings. NHI is mandatory (US-11.1.4, US-11.1.1, US-03.1.5): no Booking or patient record without one; an incoming row without one waits on the unmatched queue and a stub shows in its place on the List (OQ-118, 4 Nov, Donald for the build). The prototype takes the NHI as optional, creates a provisional patient record, shows 'NHI pending' and seeds a no-NHI patient. Do not extend the pending path; build the stub.
reverseFindings.verify_note: intake.ts 'createdProvisional' and nhiBadge 'NHI pending' re-read; OQ-118 answer quoted.

reverseFindings.title: Completion rules follow route and times, not the Contract, with no modifier explanation
reverseFindings.explanation: Supersedes the Phase 04 completion ruling. US-03.6.1 (Verify): a Procedure completes with a Contract, a price (not Needs a price) and, only on RVG-priced Contracts, the RVG code, times and a completed modifiers step with an explanation per modifier; none of that on a fixed or open price (US-03.3.9). The prototype requires a route, an RVG code or billing line and times whenever a code is set even on a fixed price, asks for no explanation and has no Contract check.
reverseFindings.verify_note: US-03.6.1 read; validator lines 125-149 confirm route, 'RVG base code or billing line' and time requirements.

reverseFindings.title: ASA class auto-seeds modifier units
reverseFindings.explanation: Supersedes the 2026-07-22 ASA seeding values. US-03.3.4: only the age modifier and base-included modifiers are pre-applied, none locked; 'No other modifier is selected whatever the patient's ASA grade'; ASA is chosen like any modifier with an explanation. The prototype adds the AS code to M automatically from a dedicated ASA control (ASA_SEED_UNITS). OQ-95 part 1 still waits on Ben, so lower confidence: label as simplification.
reverseFindings.verify_note: fee.ts seeding and ASA_SEED_UNITS confirmed; OQ-95 text read (part 2 'neither ASA nor defaults pre-fill' is proposed, not yet confirmed by AA). Lower confidence.

reverseFindings.title: Post-op addendum is a new linked Booking on today's free session
reverseFindings.explanation: Supersedes the Phase 09 addendum reading. A pre-op or post-op event is an event on the original Procedure (time or fixed fee, own date), appears on no List, and is billed in the next run (OQ-121, 4 Nov). The prototype creates a second linked Booking (addPostOpAddendum) on a free session today that runs a full capture, submit and authorise cycle; its own comment says 'INTERIM until Phase 38b replaces the addendum Booking'.
reverseFindings.verify_note: FT-03.7 and US-03.7.1 read ('Not on a List'); code comment confirms it is a known interim.

reverseFindings.title: A prepaid invoice gets a full receivable and payable pair that pays the anaesthetist; the catalogue pays it into the AA Holding account
reverseFindings.explanation: Supersedes the Phase 09/10 pre-invoice-pair decision and the Phase 41 payee-repoint seams. Prepayment sits in the AA Holding account (a payables creditor), the pair created when an admin approves the invoice; after the procedure a journal transfer (no new invoice, no payment) goes to whoever did the List; payments are made in Xero. The prototype hands the pre-invoice to Xero as an ordinary pair that authorises the payable to the anaesthetist as the patient pays; no holding account, journal transfer, approval step or cancel refund.
reverseFindings.verify_note: US-06.5.1, 06.3.1, 06.4.1 read; 'D-pre-invoice-pair' comment and 'PHASE 41 SEAM' comments confirmed; grep finds no holding account in code.

reverseFindings.title: Unavailability (including sickness) still produces a conflict flag and the office path keeps the List
reverseFindings.explanation: Supersedes Phase 30/31 readings. US-01.5.2 (Agreed): an anaesthetist's unavailability, sickness included, is never a conflict flag; a List never stays with an unavailable anaesthetist; conflicts cover hospital closures only. US-01.6.3 also says the office does not assign onto an unavailable Slot. The prototype still raises an availability conflict for any closed Slot, 'Simulate sickness' writes Unavailable over a List that keeps its Bookings, and office assign accepts a closed session and flags it.
reverseFindings.verify_note: US-01.5.2, 01.5.4, 01.5.5, 01.6.3 read; expectedConflicts pushes kind 'availability' for a closed Slot. Earlier correction: US-01.6.3 supports the finding rather than being a tension.

reverseFindings.title: Provisional readings answered 19 October are still built as provisional (vacated-session hint, notification pool)
reverseFindings.explanation: Supersedes the Phase 32 OQ-84 recommendation and notification-pool reading. OQ-84 is answered (the mover chooses free or unavailable; only the 'still being confirmed' label is stale). OQ-79 is answered: notices are active or resolved, ticked off for the whole team, never expire, with an alert-the-office option; the prototype keeps every notice with no resolve state and a provisional caption.
reverseFindings.verify_note: Both OQ answers read; code comments 'OQ-84, open' and 'OQ-79, open' confirmed stale.

reverseFindings.title: The office moves a single Booking to any List on any day (lower confidence)
reverseFindings.explanation: Supersedes the 2026-07-22 third-review single-Booking move. A List never moves day and a Booking on another day is a cancellation plus a new Booking for any actor (OQ-87, US-02.5.2): the office flow's day picker is contradicted. A single Booking moves to a colleague free in that Slot, creating a List for it (OQ-85, stated for the anaesthetist's move); moving into an existing List is an open owner question for the office. The missing anaesthetist-side move is a gap.
reverseFindings.verify_note: Draft called the whole thing an owner question; OQ-87 does contradict picking another day. Kept as a scaffold with the day picker flagged for removal at rework.

reverseFindings.title: Office edits to a Booking write through on every tap, with no Save
reverseFindings.explanation: Supersedes the Phase 04 write-through ruling for the office. US-02.3.2 (Agreed): an admin edit applies only on explicit Save, warns on leaving with unsaved edits and records changed fields for the update email; the anaesthetist keeps write-through. The Admin Booking detail wraps the same shared body so every control writes at once; no Save or unsaved-changes handling exists in it.
reverseFindings.verify_note: US-02.3.2 acceptance criteria read; grep for save/unsaved in AdminBookingDetail finds none.

reverseFindings.title: The anaesthetist's Booking shows no calculation, units or price
reverseFindings.explanation: Supersedes the 2026-09-28 owner decision 'Anaesthetist Card shows no calculation'. US-03.3.10 (5 Nov, Verify): the anaesthetist's app shows what the price comes to as they record it, for every Contract, visible but not prominent; Donald accepted it. The prototype hides the total on the anaesthetist's Booking (showBookingTotal = actor.role !== 'anaesthetist') while the web List table still shows units and fee, so the demo is also inconsistent. Not yet put to Greg.
reverseFindings.verify_note: US-03.3.10 read; the code comment 'The anaesthetist Booking carries no calculation' confirmed.

reverseFindings.title: The payer is a per-Procedure billable-party record tied to a Billable party route
reverseFindings.explanation: Supersedes the 3rd and 7th review billable-party rulings. The payer is one per Booking (US-11.2.2, Agreed), prefilled from the patient and editable by office or anaesthetist (parent, guardian, benefactor, family trust), needing an email or NZ Post postal address (US-11.2.3), with a child-payer warning. The prototype's New guardian sheet takes name, relationship and phone only, is reachable by the office after add time and only on the Billable party route, and is scoped to the Procedure.
reverseFindings.verify_note: US-11.2.2 and US-11.2.3 read; createBillableParty fields (name, relationship, phone, optional email/address) confirmed.

reverseFindings.title: Funding split is an office-only per-line editor, not a Booking action with typed $ or %
reverseFindings.explanation: Supersedes the 7th review per-line funder allocation. US-08.2.3: any user presses a split button on a Procedure and types each party's share as $ or %; each party gets its own invoice; no Contract or Procedure setting. The prototype's editor is office-only (setBillingLineAllocation), per billing line, amounts only, must sum to the fee. The two-funder outcome is kept.
reverseFindings.verify_note: US-08.2.3 read; 'Office-only' and conservation guard confirmed in code.

reverseFindings.title: Contracts carry effective dates and can be deleted; an expired Contract falls back or fails billing; the S4 beat depends on it
reverseFindings.explanation: Rewritten for the 5 Nov flat model. A Contract has no dates or versions: Active or Disabled, edited in place with audit (the prototype's in-place edit is now right), never deleted; only a fixed price is dated, through price ranges (US-04.2.15); a setting changing from a date is a new Contract; a fixed price with no range in force is not offered; a Procedure with no price 'Needs a price' and blocks AUTHORISED (US-05.2.8). The prototype gives every Contract effective-from/to dates selected by List date, silently falls expired hospital/insurer Contracts back to the default or fails the Booking, lets the office delete a Contract, and the S4 trigger end-dates COS ACC to cause the failure. Per-Booking failure is backed (US-08.5.2); the cause and fix are not. Donald's decisions, not yet confirmed by AA or Greg.
reverseFindings.verify_note: US-04.1.2, 04.1.3, 04.2.10 (Retired), 04.2.15, 05.2.8 read; S4 trigger code (editContract effectiveToISO) confirmed.

reverseFindings.title: The GST report lists customer receipts, not payments passed to the anaesthetist
reverseFindings.explanation: Supersedes the Phase 10 GST-activity reading. US-12.2.2 (Verify) is a monthly list of the payments AA has passed to the anaesthetist with the GST component of each (cash basis; agency treatment still OQ-29). The prototype's gstActivityFor reads the receipts ledger, so it lists receipts on the day the customer pays, before any payout, on mobile and web.
reverseFindings.verify_note: gstActivityFor doc comment 'amounts RECEIVED' read; US-12.2.2 text confirms 'payments AA made to the anaesthetist, not invoices sent'.

reverseFindings.title: The office's Run payables button makes the payment to anaesthetists; the catalogue says Xero pays and the system only tracks it
reverseFindings.explanation: Supersedes the Phase 10 payables-run reading in which the system disburses. OQ-111 (4 Nov, Donald for the build, not yet seen by Greg): Xero handles all payments; the ACCPAY is paid in Xero's payables run and the system detects it by webhook or poll and records the disbursement; payments follow a weekly cycle (US-10.2.7, Proposed). The Admin billing monitor has an unbadged Payables run card whose button disburses every authorised payable in-app. The two-state money model is right; the actor is not. Keep the action only as a badged Xero stand-in and show detection in the product screen.
reverseFindings.verify_note: OQ-111 answer quoted; the card comment says 'unbadged office action' and runPayables is office-only disbursement.

reverseFindings.title: Dashboard Productivity and Leave panels
reverseFindings.explanation: US-12.2.3 (Agreed) names calendar, financial position and locum availability only. Productivity tiles (units, lists, fees, six-month trend) have no backing (the word survives only in an old screenshot caption), and the Leave rows (Approved, Pending) imply an approval workflow while availability is something the anaesthetist sets herself. Both are seeded for one persona, not derived from Bookings or Slots.
reverseFindings.verify_note: US-12.2.3 body read; grep finds no other story on productivity or leave approval.

reverseFindings.title: Receivables ageing buckets, age chips and an Overdue view
reverseFindings.explanation: US-12.2.1 (Agreed) and OQ-59: a flat list of unpaid payables, oldest first, no ageing buckets, age chips or Overdue view; each line links back to its Booking. The prototype shows ageing bars, an Overdue tab with bucket columns and an amber age chip on mobile rows, and rows open nothing.
reverseFindings.verify_note: US-12.2.1 text says 'no ageing buckets and no age chips' verbatim; bucket code and AgeChip confirmed.

reverseFindings.title: Prior balance tag has no threshold and appears only on the billing monitor after authorisation
reverseFindings.explanation: US-11.3.2 (Agreed): the alert fires when a Booking is created or matched, for an unpaid invoice older than a configurable 90-day threshold (mild or strong, never blocking), and the anaesthetist also sees it on the Booking. The prototype tags any open prior episode with no threshold, only for the office, only after authorisation (its own tooltip says open versus overdue is not yet distinguished).
reverseFindings.verify_note: US-11.3.2 read; patientHasOutstandingPriorEpisode has no age test.

reverseFindings.title: Review flag 'ACC should not bill the patient directly'
reverseFindings.explanation: ACC is a funding tag on a Contract, not a kind of Contract or a route, and the engine has no ACC rule (US-05.5.1: ACC is never invoiced by AA and the engine does not see it). The catalogue does not forbid billing the patient on an ACC-related Booking, so the flag states a rule nobody has asked for. It is derived from the billing route and falls away with RV-18. Low severity.
reverseFindings.verify_note: Draft implied the catalogue contradicts the flag; it only gives no backing. Reworded as unbacked, low severity; action unchanged.

reverseFindings.title: Modifier master is demo-plausible values and codes that differ from the transcribed RVG table
reverseFindings.explanation: The modifier master is the RVG table plus AA's own, values as the RVG prints them (US-05.1.5, Agreed). The prototype's 20 rows are labelled demo-plausible and disagree (AS3 is 3, RVG 2; PA3, PA4, PA5, OB2, OB4 differ; AS2, PO1, PO2 absent from RVG; VM1, TTE, PACU, EAA, POC missing); age codes are ordinary chips rather than pre-applied. Pinned seed fees depend on AS3 = 3.
reverseFindings.verify_note: Compared row by row with artifacts/files/NZSA RVG 2021 modifiers.md; all stated differences hold.

reverseFindings.title: The RVG code master is about thirty demo-plausible codes, not the NZSA RVG groups
reverseFindings.explanation: The RVG groups are held as the NZSA guide publishes them (H1, H7A, S1 to S10 and so on, with published base units and ranges), and the anaesthetist finds one by typing 'H1'. The prototype's master is labelled 'demo-plausible ... not sourced from an NZSA schedule': about 30 invented five-digit codes (20941, 47516, 49558) with demo base units, and fixed Contract prices are keyed on them. The P1 wiring in RV-09 and the modifier values in RV-38 sit on the same demo data. Reseed from the RVG transcription together with RV-09 and RV-38.
reverseFindings.verify_note: Missed by the reverse checker. Header of rvgCodes.ts states the values are demo; US-05.1.1 and US-05.1.4 use real RVG codes (H7A, S1 to S10).

reverseSummary: Verified 38 draft findings against the catalogue items and code at efe123c5. None refuted, no ids dropped. Corrected 4: RV-08 (only the above-four modifier split is wrong; four-or-fewer matches the live rule), RV-10 (the main B stepper is not clamped; the defects are the in-range completion check and the missing out-of-range office warning), RV-27 (OQ-87 and US-02.5.2 do contradict the office day picker, but moving into an existing List is an open owner question), RV-37 (the catalogue gives no backing for the ACC flag but does not forbid it; low severity). Added 1: RV-41 (RVG code master is about thirty invented five-digit demo codes, not the NZSA RVG groups). The remaining 34 were upheld, with RV-22 lower confidence (OQ-95 part 1 awaits Ben) and RV-18, RV-21, RV-32 and RV-39 resting on Donald's unconfirmed 5 Nov decisions. The draft summary said 39 findings, but it listed 38 (RV-12 and RV-17 are unused), so the final count is 39. Updated docs/prototype-build/catch-up/analysis/reverse-check.md: header counts, RV-08, RV-10, RV-27 and RV-37 text, two retired-table rows, new RV-41 entry and a closing Adversarial verification section.
